11	# Decision: OpenSpec → Corgi Branding 全面替换
12	
13	> 将所有用户可见的 "OpenSpec" 品牌文本替换为 "Corgi"，使命令、Skill 描述、CLI 输出、文档与斜杠命令 `/corgi-*` 命名一致。
14	
15	## Context
16	
17	CorgiSpec 项目起源于 OpenSpec GitFlow 工作流，CLI 工具和斜杠命令已迁移到 `corgispec`/`/corgi-*` 命名体系。经 agent team 全面审查确认：**~85 个文件、~180+ 处引用** 中仍然大量保留 "OpenSpec" 品牌文本（另有 200+ 文件中的 `openspec/` 目录路径引用不在本次范围内）。
18	
19	| 位置 | 示例 | 用户影响 |
20	|------|------|---------|
21	| 命令描述 | `.opencode/commands/corgi-install.md` — "Install OpenSpec GitFlow assets" | OpenCode 命令面板显示 "OpenSpec" |
22	| Claude 命令名 | `.claude/commands/corgi/install.md` — `name: "OPSX: Install"` | Claude Code 命令列表显示 "OPSX" |
23	| Skill 描述 | `SKILL.md` frontmatter — "Implement tasks from an OpenSpec change" | Agent 执行时展示 "OpenSpec" |
24	| CLI description | `corgispec --help` — "Unified CLI for OpenSpec workflow" | 终端帮助文本显示 "OpenSpec" |
25	| 插件市场 | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` — `"displayName": "CorgiSpec - OpenSpec GitFlow"` | Codex/Claude 插件列表显示混用命名 |
26	| 资产模板 | `packages/corgispec/assets/` — 安装源模板含 "OpenSpec" | 每次 `corgi-install` 把 "OpenSpec" 重新写入目标项目 |
27	| 文档 | `AGENTS.md`, README, wiki pages, 对外文章 | 用户阅读时看到混用命名 |
28	
29	用户在 OpenCode 中执行 `/corgi-install` 时，命令面板和 Skill 执行输出仍显示 "OpenSpec"，造成品牌混淆。更严重的是，`packages/corgispec/assets/` 中的源模板未被考虑——即使改了部署文件，下一次 `corgi-install` 会重新引入 "OpenSpec" 文本。
30	
31	## Scope Definition
32	
33	### 替换规则
34	
35	- **品牌文本** `"OpenSpec"` → `"Corgi"`（大小写敏感，仅匹配大写 O+S）
36	- **目录路径** `openspec/` → **保留不变**
37	- **Code 标识符**（如 `OpenSpecConfig` 接口名、`initializeOpenSpec()` 函数名）→ **不改**（属于代码重构，非品牌问题）
38	
39	### 需要替换的（品牌文本 "OpenSpec"）
40	
41	| # | 类别 | 文件数 | 行数（估） | 说明 |
42	|---|------|--------|-----------|------|
43	| 1 | 命令 dispatch 文件 | 4 | ~8 | `.opencode/commands/corgi-*.md` + `.claude/commands/corgi/*.md` 的 description + 正文 |
44	| 2 | 🔴 **资产源模板** | **12** | ~25 | `packages/corgispec/assets/` — 命令模板(4) + Skill 模板(7) + meta.json(1)。**不改则每次 install 重新引入 OpenSpec** |
45	| 3 | Skill SKILL.md | 21 | ~40 | 三平台 × 7 个 skill 的 frontmatter + 正文 |
46	| 4 | CLI 源码 | 8 | ~15 | `corgispec.ts` description、bootstrap/doctor/init 输出文案 |
47	| 5 | skill.meta.json | 3 | ~3 | description 字段 |
48	| 6 | 测试文件 | 2 | ~5 | `init.test.ts`、`doctor.test.ts` — CLI 输出变更后断言会失败 |
49	| 7 | package.json | 1 | ~2 | npm package description（对外可见）；keywords 中的 `"openspec"` 需评估 |
50	| 8 | 插件 marketplace JSON | 3 | ~6 | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`、`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`、`.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` |
51	| 9 | README | 2 | ~20 | `README.md` + `README.zh-TW.md`（项目门面） |
52	| 10 | 文档 | 20 | ~60 | docs/ (12) + wiki/ (8) + 根配置 (2: AGENTS.md, INSTALL.md) |
53	| 11 | memory/MEMORY.md | 1 | ~2 | 项目描述中的 "OpenSpec GitFlow" |
54	
55	**总计**：约 **80-85 个文件**，~180+ 处替换。（初审估计 54 个文件，经 agent review 发现遗漏 ~30 个文件。）
56	
57	### 🔴 关键：资产源模板（assets/）
58	
59	这是初审遗漏的最严重类别。`packages/corgispec/assets/` 是 `corgispec install` 和 `corgispec bootstrap` 复制到目标项目的**源模板**。包含：
60	
61	```
62	packages/corgispec/assets/
63	├── commands/
64	│   ├── opencode/corgi-apply.md      ← 含 "OpenSpec change"
65	│   ├── opencode/corgi-install.md    ← 含 "OpenSpec GitFlow assets"
66	│   ├── claude/corgi/apply.md        ← 含 "OpenSpec change" + name: "OPSX: Apply"
67	│   └── claude/corgi/install.md      ← 含 "OpenSpec GitFlow assets" + name: "OPSX: Install"
68	├── skills/
69	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-apply-change/SKILL.md
70	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-explore/SKILL.md
71	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-gh-apply/SKILL.md
72	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-gh-explore/SKILL.md
73	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-install/SKILL.md
74	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-memory-migrate/SKILL.md
75	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-install/skill.meta.json
76	│   └── atoms/corgispec-memory-init/SKILL.md
77	└── schemas/{gitlab,github}-tracked/**  ← 无 OpenSpec 文本，无需改动
78	```
79	
80	**不改这些文件 = 每次 `corgispec install` 把 "OpenSpec" 重新写入目标项目，品牌替换全部白做。**
81	
82	### 不替换的（目录路径约定 `openspec/`）
83	
84	`openspec/` 是项目目录结构的约定名称（类似 `.git/`、`node_modules/`），不是品牌文本：
85	
86	```
87	openspec/config.yaml       ← 目录约定，不改
88	openspec/changes/          ← 目录约定，不改
89	openspec/schemas/          ← 目录约定，不改
90	openspec/specs/            ← 目录约定，不改
91	openspec/.corgi-install.json  ← 目录约定，不改
92	```
93	
94	**理由**：
95	1. `openspec/` 出现在 200+ 个文件中，改名是结构性变更，非品牌问题
96	2. `openspec/` 是跨项目的工作流标准目录名（类比 `.github/`、`.gitlab/`），改名会破坏与外部工具链的兼容性
97	3. 与本次品牌一致性目标无关
98	
99	### 不替换的（Code 标识符）
100	
101	以下 TypeScript 源码中的标识符是代码命名，不是品牌文本，不在本次范围：
102	
103	| 文件 | 标识符 | 类型 |
104	|------|--------|------|
105	| `lib/config.ts` | `OpenSpecConfig` interface | 接口名 |
106	| `commands/init.ts` | `InitializeOpenSpecOptions` | 类型别名 |
107	| `commands/init.ts` | `initializeOpenSpec()` | 函数名 |
108	| `lib/config.ts` | JSDoc `"OpenSpec config"` | 开发者文档（可选改） |
109	
110	### 不需要替换的（已正确使用 Corgi 命名的）
111	
112	- `corgispec` CLI 工具名 — 已正确
113	- `/corgi-*` 斜杠命令名 — 已正确
114	- `corgispec-*` Skill 目录名 — 已正确
115	- `packages/corgispec/` 包名 — 已正确
116	
117	## 命名一致性问题
118	
119	Agent review 发现提议的 "Corgi" 品牌与现存多处命名存在冲突，需在替换时统一决策：
120	
121	### 冲突矩阵
122	
123	| 现存名称 | 出现位置 | 与 "Corgi" 的关系 | 建议处理 |
124	|----------|---------|-------------------|---------|
125	| `"CorgiSpec"` | 3 个插件 `displayName` | 多出 "Spec" 后缀 | 改为 `"Corgi"`，与决策一致 |
126	| `"Coding Corgi Flow"` | README 标题 | 产品线全名 | 保留作为产品全名，简化引用用 "Corgi" |
127	| `"Corgi Flow"` | README 正文 | 产品简称 | 保留，与 "Corgi" 品牌不冲突 |
128	| `"OPSX: *"` | 6 个 Claude 命令 `name` 字段 | OpenSpec X 缩写残余 | 改为 `"Corgi: *"` |
129	| `"CorgiSpec - OpenSpec GitFlow"` | `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` | 混用 | 改为 `"Corgi"` |
130	
131	### `OPSX` 缩写残余
132	
133	`.claude/commands/corgi/*.md` 中 6 个文件的 `name` frontmatter 使用 `"OPSX: XXX"`：
134	
135	```
136	apply.md:    name: "OPSX: Apply"
137	install.md:  name: "OPSX: Install"
138	propose.md:  name: "OPSX: Propose"
139	review.md:   name: "OPSX: Review"
140	archive.md:  name: "OPSX: Archive"
141	explore.md:  name: "OPSX: Explore"
142	```
143	
144	需全部改为 `"Corgi: XXX"`，包括对应的 assets/ 源模板。
145	
146	### `metadata.author: "openspec"`（小写）
147	
148	SKILL.md frontmatter 中的 `metadata.author: "openspec"` 是小写，case-sensitive grep 会漏掉。需单独搜 `author:` 字段，替换为 `"corgispec"`（匹配 CLI 工具名）。
149	
150	### 外部归属引用（不可改）
151	
152	以下是对上游项目 Fission-AI/OpenSpec 的真实引用，**必须保留**：
153	- README 中 "OpenSpec 的社区扩展"、"原生 OpenSpec vs. Corgi Flow"
154	- 指向 `https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec` 的链接
155	- 对外文章中标明 "基于 OpenSpec 构建" 的归属声明
156	
157	区分标准：如果 "OpenSpec" 指的**是 Fission AI 的项目** → 保留；如果指**本项目/本工作流** → 替换为 "Corgi"。
158	
159	## 特殊情况处理
160	
161	| 原文 | 处理方式 | 原因 |
162	|------|---------|------|
163	| `"OPSX: Install"` (Claude 命令 name) | → `"Corgi: Install"` | OPSX = OpenSpec X 缩写残余 |
164	| `"Unified CLI for OpenSpec workflow"` (corgispec.ts, package.json) | → `"Unified CLI for Corgi workflow"` | CLI + npm 自身描述 |
165	| `"OpenSpec GitFlow"` | → `"Corgi GitFlow"` | 组合品牌名 |
166	| `"OpenSpec Awareness"` (explore skill heading) | → `"Corgi Awareness"` | Skill 章节标题，指本工作流系统 |
167	| `"OpenSpec managed files"` (install skill legacy message) | → `"Corgi managed files"` | Skill 运行时消息，指本项目管理文件 |
168	| `metadata.author: "openspec"` (小写) | → `"corgispec"` | 小写 frontmatter 值，case-sensitive grep 会漏掉 |
169	| `"openspec/..."` (目录路径) | **保留不变** | 目录约定，非品牌文本 |
170	| `"openspec-llm-memory"` (文件名) | **保留不变** | 文件名约定，历史文档标识 |
171	| `"OpenSpec"` 指 Fission AI 上游项目 | **保留不变** | 外部归属，非本项目品牌 |
172	| `OpenSpecConfig` / `initializeOpenSpec()` (TS 标识符) | **保留不变** | 代码命名，非品牌文本 |
173	| `"keywords": ["openspec", ...]` (package.json) | 待定 | npm 关键词：改则丢失可发现性，不改则留 "openspec" 残余 |
174	| `.codex/skills.backup/` vs `.codex/skills/` | **先同步，再替换** | backup 目录内容与主目录不一致（缺失 Context Gate 模式），直接编辑会掩盖差异 |
175	
176	## Decision
177	
178	**全面替换品牌文本 "OpenSpec" → "Corgi"，保留 `openspec/` 目录路径和外部归属引用不变。**
179	
180	执行原则：
181	1. **品牌文本替换**：所有 description、frontmatter、CLI 输出、文档正文中的 "OpenSpec" → "Corgi"
182	2. **目录路径保留**：`openspec/config.yaml`、`openspec/changes/` 等路径引用保持不变
183	3. **文件名保留**：`openspec-llm-memory.md` 等历史文档文件名中的 "openspec" 保留
184	4. **Code 标识符保留**：`OpenSpecConfig`、`initializeOpenSpec()` 等 TS 标识符不改
185	5. **外部归属保留**：指向 Fission-AI/OpenSpec 的引用和链接不变
186	6. **资产源模板必改**：`packages/corgispec/assets/` 必须同步替换，否则每次 install 重新引入 "OpenSpec"
187	7. **三平台同步**：`.opencode/skills/`、`.claude/skills/`、`.codex/skills.backup/` 同时替换
188	8. **先记录决策，后执行**：本决策文档作为变更依据，实际替换在审批后单独执行
189	
190	## Implementation Plan
191	
192	分 4 个阶段，按「风险 × 可验证性」排序：低风险先做建立信心，有编译器安全网的先做降低 review 成本。
193	
194	### Phase 0: 前置准备
195	
196	- 将 `.codex/skills.backup/` 内容同步到与 `.opencode/skills/` 一致（当前 backup 目录缺失 Context Gate 模式，内容过期）
197	- 确认 `package.json` keywords 中 `"openspec"` 的处理策略
198	
199	### Phase 1: 命令 dispatch 文件（低风险，用户直接可见）
200	
201	- 6 个文件（`.opencode/commands/corgi-*.md` × 2 + `.claude/commands/corgi/*.md` × 4）
202	- 改动量：frontmatter description + 正文首段 + `name: "OPSX: *"` → `"Corgi: *"`
203	- **验证**：OpenCode 命令面板无 "OpenSpec"；Claude Code `/corgi:install` 显示 "Corgi: Install"
204	
205	### Phase 2: 资产源模板 + CLI 源码（中风险，编译器安全网）
206	
207	**2a. assets/ 源模板：**
208	- 12 个文件（命令模板 4 + Skill 模板 7 + meta.json 1）
209	- 与 Phase 1 、Phase 3 的对应文件内容镜像一致
210	- **验证**：`corgispec install --mode fresh` 到测试项目，检查目标文件不含 "OpenSpec"
211

214	- **验证**：`npm test` 全部通过（测试文件需同步改断言字符串）

222	- 每文件改动点：2-5 处

228

231	- 文档 (20)：docs/ + wiki/ + AGENTS.md + INSTALL.md

235	## Risk Assessment
236	
237	| 风险 | 等级 | 缓解措施 |
238	|------|------|---------|
239	| `openspec/` 路径误替换 | 🔴 高 | 大小写区分：替换 "OpenSpec"（大写 O+S），不动 "openspec/"（小写）。每阶段后用 `grep` 验证 |
240	| assets/ 源模板遗忘 | 🔴 高 | Phase 2a 独立处理，用 `corgispec install --mode fresh` 实测验证 |
241	| 资产模板与部署文件不一致 | 🟡 中 | assets/ 和 .opencode/commands/ / .claude/commands/ 必须镜像一致，diff 验证 |
242	| Skill 文本改动影响 Agent 行为 | 🟡 中 | 仅改品牌词（"OpenSpec change" → "Corgi change"），不改指令语义或逻辑结构 |
243	| 三平台 skill 文件不同步 | 🟡 中 | Phase 3 三平台同时改；Phase 0 先同步 .codex |
244	| 测试断言因 CLI 文案变更而失败 | 🟡 中 | Phase 2b 包含测试文件更新；`npm test` 作为验证步骤 |
245	| 小写 `author: openspec` 被漏掉 | 🟡 中 | 单独 grep `author:` frontmatter 字段，不依赖 case-sensitive "OpenSpec" 搜索 |
246	| 误改对 Fission-AI/OpenSpec 的外部归属 | 🟡 中 | README 和对外文章中「指上游项目」的 "OpenSpec" 手动排除 |
247	| 文档中历史引用混乱 | 🟢 低 | 活跃文档改品牌文本，历史研究/归档文档保留原引用 |
248	| package.json keywords 取舍 | 🟢 低 | 单独决策：npm 可发现性 vs 品牌一致性 |
249	
250	## Alternatives Considered
251	
252	- **只改命令描述**：改动量最小，但 Skill 执行时 Agent 仍输出 "OpenSpec"，品牌不一致未根治。拒绝。
253	- **改成 "CorgiSpec"**：保留 "Spec" 后缀体现规格化定位。但插件 displayName 已是 "CorgiSpec"，README 是 "Coding Corgi Flow"，命令是 `/corgi-*`，再加一个品牌名造成 4 种命名并存。拒绝。
254	- **改成 "Corgi Flow"**：与 README 简称一致。但 CLI help 和 Skill 描述中 "Corgi Flow workflow" 冗余。拒绝。
255	- **连目录一起改 `openspec/` → `corgi/`**：影响 200+ 个文件，破坏与已有项目的兼容性。属于未来独立迁移项目，与本次品牌文本替换分开。拒绝。
256	
257	## Consequences
258	
259	### 正面
260	- 用户在 OpenCode/Claude Code 中看到一致的 "Corgi" 品牌
261	- 命令名 `/corgi-*`、Skill 名 `corgispec-*`、描述文本 "Corgi" 三者一致
262	- `corgispec install` 不再把 "OpenSpec" 文本写入目标项目
263	- 消除新用户的认知混淆（"为什么 /corgi-install 装的是 OpenSpec？"）
264	
265	### 负面
266	- 80-85 个文件的批量修改有协调成本
267	- 三平台 skill 同步增加维护负担（但这是已有义务，非新增）
268	- `.codex/skills.backup/` 需先同步再改，增加前置步骤
269	- 对外已发布的文章（知乎等）中引用 "OpenSpec" 需同步更新
270	- `package.json` keywords 中的 `"openspec"` 取舍需额外决策
271	
272	### 不作为的风险
273	- 品牌分裂持续，每个新用户都会产生 "OpenSpec vs Corgi" 的困惑
274	- 随着 `/corgi-*` 命令使用量增长，OpenSpec 残余引用显得越来越突兀
275	- `corgispec install` 持续把 "OpenSpec" 写入新项目，问题扩散
276	
277	## Verification
278

1	# AGENTS.md
2	
3	## What this repo is
4	
5	A workflow/skills toolkit (not an app) that turns AI coding assistants into structured engineering workflows via OpenSpec. It ships skills, schemas, CLI tooling, and slash commands for Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex.
6	
7	There is no application code to build or deploy. The "product" is the skill files and their metadata.
8	
9	## Directory layout
10	
11	| Path | Role |
12	|------|------|
13	| `.opencode/skills/corgispec-*/` | **Source of truth** for skill definitions (SKILL.md + skill.meta.json) |
14	| `.opencode/commands/corgi-*.md` | OpenCode slash command dispatch |
15	| `.claude/skills/corgispec-*/` | Claude Code skill mirrors — must stay in sync with `.opencode/skills/` |
16	| `.codex/skills/corgispec-*/` | Codex skill mirrors — must stay in sync with `.opencode/skills/` |
17	| `openspec/schemas/` | Schema definitions (gitlab-tracked, github-tracked) |
18	| `openspec/config.yaml` | Project-level config (schema, isolation, context) |
19	| `schemas/skill-meta.schema.json` | JSON Schema for validating `skill.meta.json` |
20	| `packages/corgispec/` | **corgispec CLI** — unified CLI replacing ds-skills + install-skills.sh |
21	| `tools/ds-skills/` | Node CLI for skill validation + dependency graphing (legacy, use corgispec instead) |
22	| `install-skills.sh` | Installs user-level skills (legacy, use `corgispec install` instead) |
23	
24	## Commands
25	
26	### Run corgispec tests
27	
28	```bash
29	cd packages/corgispec && npm test
30	```
31	
32	Uses Vitest. Requires Node >= 18.
33	
34	### Validate all skills (the closest thing to a build/lint step)
35	
36	```bash
37	cd tools/ds-skills && npm install && node bin/ds-skills.js validate --path ../..
38	```
39	
40	### Run ds-skills tests
41	
42	```bash
43	cd tools/ds-skills && npm test
44	```
45	
46	Uses Node.js built-in test runner (`node --test`). Requires Node >= 18.
47	
48	### Other ds-skills commands
49	
50	```bash
51	node bin/ds-skills.js list --path ../..    # list all skills
52	node bin/ds-skills.js graph --path ../..   # dependency graph
53	```
54	
55	### Install skills to user level
56	
57	```bash
58	./install-skills.sh          # copies to ~/.claude/skills/ and ~/.config/opencode/skill/
59	./install-skills.sh --dry-run  # preview only
60	```
61	
62	## Skill authoring rules
63	
64	- Each skill lives in its own directory with exactly two files: `SKILL.md` (instructions) and `skill.meta.json` (metadata).
65	- `skill.meta.json` must validate against `schemas/skill-meta.schema.json`.
66	- Skill slugs are kebab-case, must match the directory name.
67	- Tier hierarchy: `atom` (no deps) -> `molecule` (depends on atoms) -> `compound` (depends on molecules/atoms).
68	- Platform field: `universal`, `github`, or `gitlab`.
69	- `corgispec-gh-*` skills are GitHub variants; unprefixed `corgispec-*` are GitLab or universal.
70	
71	## Three-directory sync obligation
72	
73	`.opencode/skills/`, `.claude/skills/`, and `.codex/skills/` must contain equivalent skill content. When editing a skill, update all three directories. The `.opencode/skills/` version is canonical.
74	
75	## No CI
76	
77	There are no CI workflows. Validation is manual via `ds-skills validate` or `corgispec validate`.
78	
79	## Config
80	
81	- `openspec/config.yaml` controls which schema (`gitlab-tracked` or `github-tracked`) is active and optional worktree isolation settings.
82	- `.opencode/package.json` only declares `@opencode-ai/plugin` — this enables skill discovery in OpenCode sessions.
83	
84	## Conventions
85	
86	- Markdown skill files reference tool names generically. Platform-specific tool mapping is handled at runtime by each AI platform.
87	- The workflow is checkpoint-based: propose -> apply (one Task Group at a time) -> review -> archive.
88	- Delta specs use ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED/RENAMED operations.
89	
90	## Coding Guidelines
91	
92	Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Merge with project-specific instructions as needed.
93	
94	> **Tradeoff:** These guidelines bias toward caution over speed. For trivial tasks, use judgment.
95	
96	### 1. Think Before Coding
97	
98	Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.
99	
100	Before implementing:
101	- State your assumptions explicitly. If uncertain, ask.
102	- If multiple interpretations exist, present them — don't pick silently.
103	- If a simpler approach exists, say so. Push back when warranted.
104	- If something is unclear, stop. Name what's confusing. Ask.
105	
106	### 2. Simplicity First
107	
108	Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.
109	
110	- No features beyond what was asked.
111	- No abstractions for single-use code.
112	- No "flexibility" or "configurability" that wasn't requested.
113	- No error handling for impossible scenarios.
114	- If you write 200 lines and it could be 50, rewrite it.
115	
116	Ask yourself: *"Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated?"* If yes, simplify.
117	
118	### 3. Surgical Changes
119	
120	Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.
121	
122	When editing existing code:
123	- Don't "improve" adjacent code, comments, or formatting.
124	- Don't refactor things that aren't broken.
125	- Match existing style, even if you'd do it differently.
126	- If you notice unrelated dead code, mention it — don't delete it.
127	
128	When your changes create orphans:
129	- Remove imports/variables/functions that YOUR changes made unused.
130	- Don't remove pre-existing dead code unless asked.
131	
132	**The test:** Every changed line should trace directly to the user's request.
133	
134	### 4. Goal-Driven Execution
135	
136	Define success criteria. Loop until verified.
137	
138	Transform tasks into verifiable goals:
139	- "Add validation" → "Write tests for invalid inputs, then make them pass"
140	- "Fix the bug" → "Write a test that reproduces it, then make it pass"
141	- "Refactor X" → "Ensure tests pass before and after"
142	
143	For multi-step tasks, state a brief plan:
144	```
145	1. [Step] → verify: [check]
146	2. [Step] → verify: [check]
147	3. [Step] → verify: [check]
148	```
149	
150	Strong success criteria let you loop independently. Weak criteria ("make it work") require constant clarification.
151	
152	---
153	
154	*These guidelines are working if: fewer unnecessary changes in diffs, fewer rewrites due to overcomplication, and clarifying questions come before implementation rather than after mistakes.*
155	
156	## Session Memory Protocol
157	
158	### Startup (every session)
159	Read in order, max 3 files:
160	1. `memory/session-bridge.md` — last session's state
161	2. `wiki/hot.md` — current project context (~500 words, hard cap 600)
162	3. `wiki/index.md` — jump to relevant domain page
163	Then read `docs/` or code as needed.
164	
165	### Retrieval Budget
166	- Startup: max 3 files (session-bridge + hot + index), then on-demand
167	- Per-question: max 2 wiki pages before answering
168	- If >5 pages needed: say "this needs a deep session"
169	
170	### File Size Limits (hard caps)
171	| File | Target | Hard Cap | Overflow Action |
172	|------|--------|----------|-----------------|
173	| wiki/hot.md | 500 words | 600 words | Trim oldest entries |
174	| wiki/index.md | 40 lines | 80 lines | Archive completed entries |
175	| memory/pitfalls.md | 10 active | 20 active | Rotate oldest 10 |
176	| memory/session-bridge.md | 30 lines | 50 lines | Archive old Done items |
177	
178	### Shutdown (every session end)
179	Update `memory/session-bridge.md`: Done / Waiting / New Pitfalls / New Discoveries
180	
181	### corgi Apply -> Long-term Memory
182	After each Task Group completes:
183	- New pitfalls -> append to `memory/pitfalls.md` (link source change)
184	- New implicit rules -> append to `wiki/architecture/implicit-contracts.md`
185	- Update `wiki/hot.md` Recent Decisions
186	
187	### Compaction Triggers (agent self-maintains)
188	- Every archive: compress session-bridge
189	- pitfalls > 20 entries: rotate oldest 10 to Archive section
190	- hot.md > 550 words: trim oldest entries
191	- Every 10 corgi sessions: suggest running /corgi-lint

6	# MEMORY — Hard Constraints
7	
8	> AI agent must obey these every session. Never expires.
9	
10	## Project Identity
11	- **Name**: OpenSpec GitFlow
12	- **Purpose**: Turn AI coding assistants into structured engineering workflows with schema-driven planning, checkpoint-based implementation, and full issue tracking on GitLab or GitHub.
13	- **Stack**: Markdown skill definitions, JSON schema metadata, Node.js CLIs (`corgispec`, `ds-skills`), OpenSpec schemas/config, OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub/GitLab CLI integrations
14	
15	## Hard Constraints
16	- `.opencode/skills/`, `.claude/skills/`, and `.codex/skills/` must contain equivalent skill content.
17	- The `.opencode/skills/` version is canonical.
18	- Each skill directory must contain exactly `SKILL.md` and `skill.meta.json`.
19	- `skill.meta.json` must validate against `schemas/skill-meta.schema.json`.
20	- There is no application code to build or deploy; the product is the skills and metadata.
21	
22	## Preferences
23	- Prefer `corgispec` over the legacy `ds-skills` CLI and `install-skills.sh` when possible.
24	- Keep markdown skill files tool-generic; platform-specific mapping happens at runtime.
25	- Follow the checkpoint-based workflow: propose -> apply -> review -> archive.
26	- Use manual validation via `corgispec validate` or `ds-skills validate` because there is no CI.

docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:1:# OpenSpec 落地 GitHub：我们如何把 Spec、Issue、Review 和 Git 工作流接成一条线
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:5:**摘要：** 很多团队已经能用 AI 生成 proposal、spec、design 和 tasks，真正的难点却是这些产物常常停在本地，进不了 GitHub 的 issue、review 与执行节奏。本文介绍我们如何以 OpenSpec 为底座，补齐 GitHub / Git 工作流，并用可复用 skills 减少重复劳动。
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:9:如果这一步没有打通，OpenSpec 更像一个很强的规划工具，而不是一个能稳定落地的工程工作流。我们这次做的事情，不是替代 OpenSpec，而是在它之上补齐一层更适合 GitHub 和日常 Git 开发的工作流能力。
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:17:## OpenSpec 已经做对了什么
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:19:OpenSpec 解决的是 AI 辅助开发里最基础、也最容易失控的一层：change artifacts，也就是 proposal、spec、design、tasks 这一组变更产物。它把这些东西组织成一个清晰的 change lifecycle，让团队不是“想到什么写什么”，而是围绕一个明确变更来生成、讨论和推进。
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:21:这一点非常重要，因为没有 artifact pipeline，后面的执行、review 和协作几乎都会变成即兴发挥。也正因为 OpenSpec 已经把这层底座搭好了，我们才有空间继续往上补：让这些 artifacts 真正进入 GitHub 和 Git 的日常工作流。
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:23:## 我们在 OpenSpec 之上补了什么
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:25:我们没有去改写 OpenSpec 的核心思路，而是在它之上补了一层更适合 GitHub 用户的 workflow glue。对普通开发者来说，最关键的不是“再多一个能生成文档的工具”，而是这些文档能不能继续流进 issue 跟踪、分组执行、review 节点和 Git 隔离。
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:27:| OpenSpec 底座 | 我们补上的能力 | 这对 GitHub 用户意味着什么 |
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:99:如果你已经在用 OpenSpec，最值得尝试的，不一定是立刻把整套流程一次性铺满，而是先挑一个 feature-sized change 跑通：从 propose 开始，到 apply、review，最后 archive。只要这条链路真的跑通一次，你就会很快感受到差别：OpenSpec 不再只是“帮你写文档”，而是开始进入你真正的 GitHub 工程流程。
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:101:对我们来说，这也是这次扩展最核心的目标：不是把 OpenSpec 换掉，而是让它更适合真实团队、更适合 GitHub 用户，也更适合那些想把 AI workflow 从 demo 拉到工程实践的人。

Here is my thorough survey and analysis.

---

## Scope of the Rebrand: Comprehensive Report

### 1. What the Plan Proposes

The decision document at `E:\code\openspec_gitflow_modified\wiki\decisions\2026-05-26\openspec-to-corgi-rebrand.md` proposes replacing all user-visible brand text "OpenSpec" with "Corgi" across the entire project. The goal is to align the user-facing brand with the `/corgi-*` slash commands and `corgispec` CLI tool name, eliminating user confusion where typing `/corgi-install` displays "Installing OpenSpec assets."

The plan is specific about what does NOT change: directory paths (`openspec/`), TypeScript code identifiers (`OpenSpecConfig`, `initializeOpenSpec()`), historical filenames (`openspec-llm-memory.md`), and external attribution to the upstream Fission-AI/OpenSpec project.

### 2. How Many Files Need Changes

The plan's estimate of **80-85 files with ~180+ brand-text occurrences** is well-founded. My survey confirms the following breakdown:

**Phase 1 -- Command dispatch files (6 files, ~8 lines):**
- `.claude/commands/corgi/apply.md`, `install.md`, `propose.md`, `review.md`, `archive.md`, `explore.md` -- Each contains `name: "OPSX: XXX"` in frontmatter plus "OpenSpec" in description/body for `apply.md` and `install.md`. Six discrete files, 6 `OPSX` names to change, plus body text.
- `.opencode/commands/corgi-install.md` and `.opencode/commands/corgi-apply.md` -- contain "OpenSpec GitFlow assets" and "OpenSpec change" respectively.

**Phase 2a -- Asset source templates (CRITICAL, ~35+ files):**
This is the most dangerous category. `packages/corgispec/assets/` contains templates that `corgispec install` copies into target projects. If these are not changed, every installation re-injects "OpenSpec" text. My survey found:
- 7 Claude command templates (`assets/commands/claude/corgi/*.md`) -- all have `name: "OPSX: XXX"` + body text with "OpenSpec"
- 10 OpenCode command templates (`assets/commands/opencode/corgi-*.md`) -- at least `install.md` and `apply.md` have "OpenSpec" text
- 17 skill SKILL.md templates across atoms/molecules -- ~13 have "OpenSpec" in frontmatter `description` or body; ALL 17 have `author: openspec` (lowercase, case-sensitive grep will miss this)
- 1 `skill.meta.json` (install skill) with "OpenSpec GitFlow" in description
- memory-init templates had zero "OpenSpec" text (a positive finding -- these are already clean)

The plan counts 12 files for this phase, which undercounts. The real number depends on how many OpenCode command templates contain brand text beyond just `install.md` and `apply.md`.

**Phase 2b -- CLI source code (6 files, ~10 occurrences):**
- `src/bin/corgispec.ts` -- "Unified CLI for OpenSpec workflow" (the CLI help description)
- `src/commands/bootstrap.ts` -- "Bootstrap OpenSpec assets"
- `src/commands/init.ts` -- "Initialize OpenSpec directory structure", console.log of "OpenSpec already initialized", "Initialized OpenSpec in..."
- `src/commands/doctor.ts` -- "not in an OpenSpec project"
- `src/commands/status.ts` -- "for an OpenSpec change"
- `src/lib/config.ts` -- JSDoc comments "The parsed and validated OpenSpec config" (the plan marks these as optional)

**Phase 2b -- Test files (2 files, ~3 occurrences):**
- `test/init.test.ts` -- asserts "Initialized OpenSpec" and "OpenSpec already initialized"
- `test/doctor.test.ts` -- asserts "not found (not in an OpenSpec project)"
These MUST be updated in lockstep with CLI source changes, or `npm test` will fail.

**Phase 3 -- Skill definitions (21 SKILL.md + ~54 `author` fields):**
- 7 skills x 3 platforms (.opencode, .claude, .codex/skills.backup) = 21 SKILL.md files
- Brand text "OpenSpec" found in: `apply-change`, `explore`, `gh-apply`, `gh-explore`, `install`, `memory-init`, `memory-migrate` (7 of 10 skill directories across all platforms)
- The `author: openspec` field (lowercase, case-sensitive grep will miss it): I counted 56 distinct files containing this pattern across the three platform directories. This is roughly 18-19 unique skill directories x 3 platforms = ~56 files, plus all 17 assets SKILL.md templates.

**Phase 4 -- Documentation, plugin configs, README (~25+ files):**
- `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` -- description "OpenSpec GitFlow", longDescription "OpenSpec GitFlow"
- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` -- description "OpenSpec GitFlow"
- `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` -- displayName "CorgiSpec - OpenSpec GitFlow" (hybrid naming)
- `README.md` and `README.zh-TW.md` -- ~8 "OpenSpec" occurrences each, but roughly half are upstream attribution (to keep)
- `AGENTS.md` -- "turns AI coding assistants into structured engineering workflows via OpenSpec" (line 5)
- `memory/MEMORY.md` -- "Name: OpenSpec GitFlow" (line 11)
- `.opencode/INSTALL.md` -- "OpenSpec GitFlow -- Agent Bootstrap" (title + body)
- `packages/corgispec/package.json` -- description "Unified CLI for OpenSpec workflow"; keywords array includes `"openspec"`
- `wiki/hot.md` -- title "OpenSpec GitFlow Latest" and body text
- `wiki/index.md` -- title "OpenSpec GitFlow Wiki Index"
- `wiki/architecture/overview.md` -- ~6 occurrences (some upstream attribution, some brand text)
- `wiki/research/codex-claude-plugin-distribution-research.md` -- ~6 occurrences (plugin description examples)
- `wiki/sessions/openspec-llm-memory.md` -- description with "OpenSpec GitFlow"
- `docs/cross-session-memory.md` / `.zh-TW.md` -- "OpenSpec GitFlow" brand text
- `docs/articles/obsidian-pm-corgi-dev-zhihu.md` -- ~20 occurrences, but most are upstream attribution (keep)
- `docs/superpowers/articles/2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md` -- all ~20+ are upstream Fission-AI/OpenSpec attribution (keep as-is)
- `packages/corgispec/CHANGELOG.md` -- 1 occurrence "scaffold OpenSpec directory structure" (historical, could keep or change)

### 3. Concerns and Contradictions

**Concern 1: The `.codex/skills.backup/` synchronization gap (High risk).**
The plan correctly flags that `.codex/skills.backup/` is out of sync with `.opencode/skills/`. It is described as "missing Context Gate patterns" and having "stale content." If the rebrand is applied to the backup directory without first syncing it to the canonical `.opencode/skills/`, you end up editing stale files -- and when the backup IS eventually synced from canonical, those edits would be lost or conflict. The plan's Phase 0 correctly proposes syncing backup from canonical first. However, the plan does not provide specific instructions for what "syncing" entails -- a full directory copy, a selective merge, or a diff review. This ambiguity could lead to problems.

**Concern 2: Asset template file count under-estimation.**
The plan lists "12" files for the assets/ source templates category. My survey found ~35 files in `packages/corgispec/assets/` that contain "OpenSpec" or "OPSX" brand text -- 7 Claude commands + 10 OpenCode commands + 17 SKILL.md + 1 skill.meta.json. The plan may be counting only "files with meaningful brand text changes" (excluding those that only need `author:` changes), but the distinction is not clearly drawn. If someone executes the plan using the "12 files" number, they will miss many.

**Concern 3: "OpenSpec" in CHANGELOG.md.**
The CHANGELOG entry "scaffold OpenSpec directory structure" (line 13) is historical release note text. The plan does not mention it. Since the directory IS literally called `openspec/`, the CHANGELOG statement is accurate and historical. Changing it to "scaffold Corgi directory structure" would be factually wrong since the directory wasn't renamed. This is an edge case the plan should address.

**Concern 4: The `author: openspec` scale.**
The plan mentions this in one paragraph ("需单独搜 `author:` 字段") but I count 56+ files across deployed skills and source templates that contain `author: openspec`. This is not a small side task -- it is roughly half of all SKILL.md edits. The plan's Phase 3 verification includes a grep command for `author: "openspec"` (lowercase), which is the correct approach. But the sheer volume (56+) means a scripted search-and-replace is probably necessary to avoid human error, and the script must be case-sensitive to avoid false positives.

**Concern 5: External attribution distinction is error-prone.**
The plan says: "if 'OpenSpec' refers to the Fission AI project, keep it." This is a human judgment call per occurrence. The risk is real -- for example, `docs/articles/obsidian-pm-corgi-dev-zhihu.md` has 15+ occurrences of "OpenSpec," about 12 are upstream attribution and 3 describe this project's workflow. A blanket grep-and-replace on that file would be disastrous. Similarly, README.md has 5 occurrences that are upstream attribution vs. 3 that are brand text. Each file must be reviewed individually, which makes Phase 4 the most labor-intensive phase despite being labeled "low risk, pure copy."

**Concern 6: `package.json` keywords -- no resolution in the plan.**
The plan marks the `"openspec"` keyword in package.json as "待定" (pending). This is not resolved. Changing it risks losing npm discoverability for users searching "openspec." Keeping it leaves a brand inconsistency in the npm registry. The Phase 0 prep step says to "确认策略" (confirm strategy), but the plan offers no recommendation. This needs a concrete decision before execution.

**Concern 7: Test coupling to CLI output strings.**
Tests in `init.test.ts` and `doctor.test.ts` assert exact string matches against CLI output (e.g., `expect(result).toContain("Initialized OpenSpec")`). When the CLI output changes to say "Corgi" instead, these tests will fail. This is correctly identified in the plan's risk matrix, and Phase 2b includes test updates. But if anyone runs `npm test` between the CLI change and the test change (e.g., if the two changes are in separate commits), CI will break. The plan should specify that these changes must be atomic (same commit).

**Concern 8: No CLAUDE.md or CODEBUDDY.md exists.**
I searched for both files -- they do not exist in this vault. The project uses `AGENTS.md` as its agent instruction file. This is fine; the plan already covers AGENTS.md. Just confirming no hidden config files were overlooked.

**Concern 9: `.obsidian/` config has no OpenSpec references.**
The `.obsidian/workspace.json` and other Obsidian config files contain only file-path references (which happen to include `openspec/` paths), no brand text. No changes needed here.

**Concern 10: `metadata.author` in assets SKILL.md templates.**
Of the 17 assets SKILL.md files, all 17 have `author: openspec`. The plan mentions this for deployed skills (Phase 3) but does not explicitly list it for Phase 2a (assets). This is a gap -- the assets templates must also have their author fields changed, or each `corgispec install` will reintroduce `author: openspec` into target projects.

### 4. Risk-Weighted Summary by Phase

| Phase | Files | Occurrences | Highest Risk |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| 0: Prep (.codex sync) | ~18 files | N/A (sync, not edit) | Content loss if sync direction is wrong |
| 1: Commands | 6-8 files | ~12 | Low -- simple frontmatter edits |
| 2a: Assets templates | 35+ files | ~50+ | **CRITICAL** -- missed files = perpetual re-infection |
| 2b: CLI source + tests | 8 files | ~12 | Tests break if not atomic with CLI changes |
| 3: Skills (3 platforms) | 21 SKILL.md + 56 author fields | ~30 + 56 author | `author:` lowercase grep miss; sync required across 3 dirs |
| 4: Docs, plugins, README | ~25 files | ~60 | External attribution false positives; most labor-intensive |

### 5. Recommendations

1. **Clarify the assets file count** in the plan. My count is ~35 files with brand text, not 12. Ensure Phase 2a enumerates every affected file explicitly.

2. **Resolve the `package.json` keywords question** before Phase 0 starts. My recommendation: remove `"openspec"` to match brand consistency; add `"corgispec"` and `"corgi-workflow"` as replacement keywords. npm discoverability via "openspec" is a short-term crutch that undermines the entire rebrand.

3. **Expand the Phase 0 sync step** with explicit instructions: compare `.codex/skills.backup/` against `.opencode/skills/` via `diff -r`, then `cp -r` from canonical to backup. Do not attempt a selective merge -- full overwrite is safest for the backup.

4. **Make Phase 2b atomic**: CLI string changes and test assertion updates must be in a single commit, with `npm test` verification between each change.

5. **Add explicit asset-template `author:` coverage to Phase 2a**. The plan mentions it for Phase 3 but not for assets. The verification grep in the plan section 2 (line 282) uses `"OpenSpec\|OPSX"` which WILL miss the lowercase `author: openspec` field -- a separate check is needed.

6. **The overall estimated effort** is high but well-scoped. The plan's 4-phase approach with independently verifiable stages is sound. The biggest execution risk is Phase 4's external attribution judgment calls, which cannot be automated and require a human or agent to read each occurrence in context.

37	- **Code 标识符**（如 `OpenSpecConfig` 接口名、`initializeOpenSpec()` 函数名）→ **不改**（属于代码重构，非品牌问题）
38	
39	### 需要替换的（品牌文本 "OpenSpec"）
40	
41	| # | 类别 | 文件数 | 行数（估） | 说明 |
42	|---|------|--------|-----------|------|
43	| 1 | 命令 dispatch 文件 | 4 | ~8 | `.opencode/commands/corgi-*.md` + `.claude/commands/corgi/*.md` 的 description + 正文 |
44	| 2 | 🔴 **资产源模板** | **12** | ~25 | `packages/corgispec/assets/` — 命令模板(4) + Skill 模板(7) + meta.json(1)。**不改则每次 install 重新引入 OpenSpec** |
45	| 3 | Skill SKILL.md | 21 | ~40 | 三平台 × 7 个 skill 的 frontmatter + 正文 |
46	| 4 | CLI 源码 | 8 | ~15 | `corgispec.ts` description、bootstrap/doctor/init 输出文案 |
47	| 5 | skill.meta.json | 3 | ~3 | description 字段 |
48	| 6 | 测试文件 | 2 | ~5 | `init.test.ts`、`doctor.test.ts` — CLI 输出变更后断言会失败 |
49	| 7 | package.json | 1 | ~2 | npm package description（对外可见）；keywords 中的 `"openspec"` 需评估 |
50	| 8 | 插件 marketplace JSON | 3 | ~6 | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`、`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`、`.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` |
51	| 9 | README | 2 | ~20 | `README.md` + `README.zh-TW.md`（项目门面） |
52	| 10 | 文档 | 20 | ~60 | docs/ (12) + wiki/ (8) + 根配置 (2: AGENTS.md, INSTALL.md) |
53	| 11 | memory/MEMORY.md | 1 | ~2 | 项目描述中的 "OpenSpec GitFlow" |
54	
55	**总计**：约 **80-85 个文件**，~180+ 处替换。（初审估计 54 个文件，经 agent review 发现遗漏 ~30 个文件。）
56	
57	### 🔴 关键：资产源模板（assets/）
58	
59	这是初审遗漏的最严重类别。`packages/corgispec/assets/` 是 `corgispec install` 和 `corgispec bootstrap` 复制到目标项目的**源模板**。包含：
60	
61	```
62	packages/corgispec/assets/
63	├── commands/
64	│   ├── opencode/corgi-apply.md      ← 含 "OpenSpec change"
65	│   ├── opencode/corgi-install.md    ← 含 "OpenSpec GitFlow assets"
66	│   ├── claude/corgi/apply.md        ← 含 "OpenSpec change" + name: "OPSX: Apply"
67	│   └── claude/corgi/install.md      ← 含 "OpenSpec GitFlow assets" + name: "OPSX: Install"
68	├── skills/
69	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-apply-change/SKILL.md
70	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-explore/SKILL.md
71	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-gh-apply/SKILL.md
72	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-gh-explore/SKILL.md
73	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-install/SKILL.md
74	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-memory-migrate/SKILL.md
75	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-install/skill.meta.json
76	│   └── atoms/corgispec-memory-init/SKILL.md
77	└── schemas/{gitlab,github}-tracked/**  ← 无 OpenSpec 文本，无需改动
78	```
79	
80	**不改这些文件 = 每次 `corgispec install` 把 "OpenSpec" 重新写入目标项目，品牌替换全部白做。**
81	
82	### 不替换的（目录路径约定 `openspec/`）
83	
84	`openspec/` 是项目目录结构的约定名称（类似 `.git/`、`node_modules/`），不是品牌文本：
85	
86	```
87	openspec/config.yaml       ← 目录约定，不改
88	openspec/changes/          ← 目录约定，不改
89	openspec/schemas/          ← 目录约定，不改
90	openspec/specs/            ← 目录约定，不改
91	openspec/.corgi-install.json  ← 目录约定，不改
92	```
93	
94	**理由**：
95	1. `openspec/` 出现在 200+ 个文件中，改名是结构性变更，非品牌问题
96	2. `openspec/` 是跨项目的工作流标准目录名（类比 `.github/`、`.gitlab/`），改名会破坏与外部工具链的兼容性
97	3. 与本次品牌一致性目标无关
98	
99	### 不替换的（Code 标识符）
100	
101	以下 TypeScript 源码中的标识符是代码命名，不是品牌文本，不在本次范围：
102	
103	| 文件 | 标识符 | 类型 |
104	|------|--------|------|
105	| `lib/config.ts` | `OpenSpecConfig` interface | 接口名 |
106	| `commands/init.ts` | `InitializeOpenSpecOptions` | 类型别名 |
107	| `commands/init.ts` | `initializeOpenSpec()` | 函数名 |
108	| `lib/config.ts` | JSDoc `"OpenSpec config"` | 开发者文档（可选改） |
109	
110	### 不需要替换的（已正确使用 Corgi 命名的）
111	
112	- `corgispec` CLI 工具名 — 已正确
113	- `/corgi-*` 斜杠命令名 — 已正确
114	- `corgispec-*` Skill 目录名 — 已正确
115	- `packages/corgispec/` 包名 — 已正确
116	
117	## 命名一致性问题
118	
119	Agent review 发现提议的 "Corgi" 品牌与现存多处命名存在冲突，需在替换时统一决策：
120	
121	### 冲突矩阵
122	
123	| 现存名称 | 出现位置 | 与 "Corgi" 的关系 | 建议处理 |
124	|----------|---------|-------------------|---------|
125	| `"CorgiSpec"` | 3 个插件 `displayName` | 多出 "Spec" 后缀 | 改为 `"Corgi"`，与决策一致 |
126	| `"Coding Corgi Flow"` | README 标题 | 产品线全名 | 保留作为产品全名，简化引用用 "Corgi" |
127	| `"Corgi Flow"` | README 正文 | 产品简称 | 保留，与 "Corgi" 品牌不冲突 |
128	| `"OPSX: *"` | 6 个 Claude 命令 `name` 字段 | OpenSpec X 缩写残余 | 改为 `"Corgi: *"` |
129	| `"CorgiSpec - OpenSpec GitFlow"` | `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` | 混用 | 改为 `"Corgi"` |
130	
131	### `OPSX` 缩写残余
132	
133	`.claude/commands/corgi/*.md` 中 6 个文件的 `name` frontmatter 使用 `"OPSX: XXX"`：
134	
135	```
136	apply.md:    name: "OPSX: Apply"
137	install.md:  name: "OPSX: Install"
138	propose.md:  name: "OPSX: Propose"
139	review.md:   name: "OPSX: Review"
140	archive.md:  name: "OPSX: Archive"
141	explore.md:  name: "OPSX: Explore"
142	```
143	
144	需全部改为 `"Corgi: XXX"`，包括对应的 assets/ 源模板。
145	
146	### `metadata.author: "openspec"`（小写）
147	
148	SKILL.md frontmatter 中的 `metadata.author: "openspec"` 是小写，case-sensitive grep 会漏掉。需单独搜 `author:` 字段，替换为 `"corgispec"`（匹配 CLI 工具名）。
149	
150	### 外部归属引用（不可改）
151	
152	以下是对上游项目 Fission-AI/OpenSpec 的真实引用，**必须保留**：
153	- README 中 "OpenSpec 的社区扩展"、"原生 OpenSpec vs. Corgi Flow"
154	- 指向 `https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec` 的链接
155	- 对外文章中标明 "基于 OpenSpec 构建" 的归属声明
156	
157	区分标准：如果 "OpenSpec" 指的**是 Fission AI 的项目** → 保留；如果指**本项目/本工作流** → 替换为 "Corgi"。
158	
159	## 特殊情况处理
160	
161	| 原文 | 处理方式 | 原因 |
162	|------|---------|------|
163	| `"OPSX: Install"` (Claude 命令 name) | → `"Corgi: Install"` | OPSX = OpenSpec X 缩写残余 |
164	| `"Unified CLI for OpenSpec workflow"` (corgispec.ts, package.json) | → `"Unified CLI for Corgi workflow"` | CLI + npm 自身描述 |
165	| `"OpenSpec GitFlow"` | → `"Corgi GitFlow"` | 组合品牌名 |
166	| `"OpenSpec Awareness"` (explore skill heading) | → `"Corgi Awareness"` | Skill 章节标题，指本工作流系统 |
167	| `"OpenSpec managed files"` (install skill legacy message) | → `"Corgi managed files"` | Skill 运行时消息，指本项目管理文件 |
168	| `metadata.author: "openspec"` (小写) | → `"corgispec"` | 小写 frontmatter 值，case-sensitive grep 会漏掉 |
169	| `"openspec/..."` (目录路径) | **保留不变** | 目录约定，非品牌文本 |
170	| `"openspec-llm-memory"` (文件名) | **保留不变** | 文件名约定，历史文档标识 |
171	| `"OpenSpec"` 指 Fission AI 上游项目 | **保留不变** | 外部归属，非本项目品牌 |
172	| `OpenSpecConfig` / `initializeOpenSpec()` (TS 标识符) | **保留不变** | 代码命名，非品牌文本 |
173	| `"keywords": ["openspec", ...]` (package.json) | 待定 | npm 关键词：改则丢失可发现性，不改则留 "openspec" 残余 |
174	| `.codex/skills.backup/` vs `.codex/skills/` | **先同步，再替换** | backup 目录内容与主目录不一致（缺失 Context Gate 模式），直接编辑会掩盖差异 |
175	
176	## Decision
177	
178	**全面替换品牌文本 "OpenSpec" → "Corgi"，保留 `openspec/` 目录路径和外部归属引用不变。**
179	
180	执行原则：
181	1. **品牌文本替换**：所有 description、frontmatter、CLI 输出、文档正文中的 "OpenSpec" → "Corgi"
182	2. **目录路径保留**：`openspec/config.yaml`、`openspec/changes/` 等路径引用保持不变
183	3. **文件名保留**：`openspec-llm-memory.md` 等历史文档文件名中的 "openspec" 保留
184	4. **Code 标识符保留**：`OpenSpecConfig`、`initializeOpenSpec()` 等 TS 标识符不改
185	5. **外部归属保留**：指向 Fission-AI/OpenSpec 的引用和链接不变
186	6. **资产源模板必改**：`packages/corgispec/assets/` 必须同步替换，否则每次 install 重新引入 "OpenSpec"
187	7. **三平台同步**：`.opencode/skills/`、`.claude/skills/`、`.codex/skills.backup/` 同时替换
188	8. **先记录决策，后执行**：本决策文档作为变更依据，实际替换在审批后单独执行
189	
190	## Implementation Plan
191	
192	分 4 个阶段，按「风险 × 可验证性」排序：低风险先做建立信心，有编译器安全网的先做降低 review 成本。
193	
194	### Phase 0: 前置准备
195	
196	- 将 `.codex/skills.backup/` 内容同步到与 `.opencode/skills/` 一致（当前 backup 目录缺失 Context Gate 模式，内容过期）
197	- 确认 `package.json` keywords 中 `"openspec"` 的处理策略
198	
199	### Phase 1: 命令 dispatch 文件（低风险，用户直接可见）
200	
201	- 6 个文件（`.opencode/commands/corgi-*.md` × 2 + `.claude/commands/corgi/*.md` × 4）
202	- 改动量：frontmatter description + 正文首段 + `name: "OPSX: *"` → `"Corgi: *"`
203	- **验证**：OpenCode 命令面板无 "OpenSpec"；Claude Code `/corgi:install` 显示 "Corgi: Install"
204	
205	### Phase 2: 资产源模板 + CLI 源码（中风险，编译器安全网）
206	
207	**2a. assets/ 源模板：**
208	- 12 个文件（命令模板 4 + Skill 模板 7 + meta.json 1）
209	- 与 Phase 1 、Phase 3 的对应文件内容镜像一致
210	- **验证**：`corgispec install --mode fresh` 到测试项目，检查目标文件不含 "OpenSpec"
211	
212	**2b. CLI 源码：**
213	- 8 个 .ts 文件（只改字符串字面量，不动标识符和 `openspec/` 路径）
214	- **验证**：`npm test` 全部通过（测试文件需同步改断言字符串）
215	
216	Phase 2a 和 2b 可并行。
217	
218	### Phase 3: Skill 定义文件（中风险，需人工 diff review）
219	
220	- 21 个 SKILL.md（三平台各 7 个）+ 3 个 skill.meta.json
221	- 改动量：frontmatter description + 正文关键位置
222	- 每文件改动点：2-5 处
223	- 需注意：`metadata.author: "openspec"` → `"corgispec"`（小写，case-sensitive grep 会漏）
224	- 需注意：`corgispec-install` skill 运行时消息 "This project has OpenSpec managed files"
225	- **验证**：`grep -rn "OpenSpec" --include="SKILL.md" .opencode/skills/ .claude/skills/ .codex/skills.backup/` → 零结果
226	
227	### Phase 4: 文档、插件配置、README（低风险，纯文案）
228	
229	- 插件 marketplace JSONs (3)：displayName + description
230	- README (2)：正文中的品牌引用（保留外部归属）
231	- 文档 (20)：docs/ + wiki/ + AGENTS.md + INSTALL.md
232	- memory/MEMORY.md (1)
233	- **验证**：`grep -rn "OpenSpec" --include="*.md" --include="*.json" .` (排除 openspec/ 路径后 → 零品牌引用)
234	
235	## Risk Assessment
236	
237	| 风险 | 等级 | 缓解措施 |
238	|------|------|---------|
239	| `openspec/` 路径误替换 | 🔴 高 | 大小写区分：替换 "OpenSpec"（大写 O+S），不动 "openspec/"（小写）。每阶段后用 `grep` 验证 |
240	| assets/ 源模板遗忘 | 🔴 高 | Phase 2a 独立处理，用 `corgispec install --mode fresh` 实测验证 |
241	| 资产模板与部署文件不一致 | 🟡 中 | assets/ 和 .opencode/commands/ / .claude/commands/ 必须镜像一致，diff 验证 |
242	| Skill 文本改动影响 Agent 行为 | 🟡 中 | 仅改品牌词（"OpenSpec change" → "Corgi change"），不改指令语义或逻辑结构 |
243	| 三平台 skill 文件不同步 | 🟡 中 | Phase 3 三平台同时改；Phase 0 先同步 .codex |
244	| 测试断言因 CLI 文案变更而失败 | 🟡 中 | Phase 2b 包含测试文件更新；`npm test` 作为验证步骤 |
245	| 小写 `author: openspec` 被漏掉 | 🟡 中 | 单独 grep `author:` frontmatter 字段，不依赖 case-sensitive "OpenSpec" 搜索 |
246	| 误改对 Fission-AI/OpenSpec 的外部归属 | 🟡 中 | README 和对外文章中「指上游项目」的 "OpenSpec" 手动排除 |
247	| 文档中历史引用混乱 | 🟢 低 | 活跃文档改品牌文本，历史研究/归档文档保留原引用 |
248	| package.json keywords 取舍 | 🟢 低 | 单独决策：npm 可发现性 vs 品牌一致性 |
249	
250	## Alternatives Considered
251	
252	- **只改命令描述**：改动量最小，但 Skill 执行时 Agent 仍输出 "OpenSpec"，品牌不一致未根治。拒绝。
253	- **改成 "CorgiSpec"**：保留 "Spec" 后缀体现规格化定位。但插件 displayName 已是 "CorgiSpec"，README 是 "Coding Corgi Flow"，命令是 `/corgi-*`，再加一个品牌名造成 4 种命名并存。拒绝。
254	- **改成 "Corgi Flow"**：与 README 简称一致。但 CLI help 和 Skill 描述中 "Corgi Flow workflow" 冗余。拒绝。
255	- **连目录一起改 `openspec/` → `corgi/`**：影响 200+ 个文件，破坏与已有项目的兼容性。属于未来独立迁移项目，与本次品牌文本替换分开。拒绝。
256	
257	## Consequences
258	
259	### 正面
260	- 用户在 OpenCode/Claude Code 中看到一致的 "Corgi" 品牌
261	- 命令名 `/corgi-*`、Skill 名 `corgispec-*`、描述文本 "Corgi" 三者一致
262	- `corgispec install` 不再把 "OpenSpec" 文本写入目标项目
263	- 消除新用户的认知混淆（"为什么 /corgi-install 装的是 OpenSpec？"）
264	
265	### 负面
266	- 80-85 个文件的批量修改有协调成本
267	- 三平台 skill 同步增加维护负担（但这是已有义务，非新增）
268	- `.codex/skills.backup/` 需先同步再改，增加前置步骤
269	- 对外已发布的文章（知乎等）中引用 "OpenSpec" 需同步更新
270	- `package.json` keywords 中的 `"openspec"` 取舍需额外决策
271	
272	### 不作为的风险
273	- 品牌分裂持续，每个新用户都会产生 "OpenSpec vs Corgi" 的困惑
274	- 随着 `/corgi-*` 命令使用量增长，OpenSpec 残余引用显得越来越突兀
275	- `corgispec install` 持续把 "OpenSpec" 写入新项目，问题扩散
276	
277	## Verification
278	
279	替换完成后需验证：
280	
281	1. **命令文件**：`grep -rn "OpenSpec\|OPSX" --include="*.md" .opencode/commands/ .claude/commands/` → 零结果
282	2. **资产模板**：`grep -rn "OpenSpec\|OPSX" --include="*.md" --include="*.json" packages/corgispec/assets/` → 零结果
283	3. **Skill 文件**：`grep -rn "OpenSpec" --include="SKILL.md" .opencode/skills/ .claude/skills/ .codex/skills.backup/` → 零结果
284	4. **小写 author**：`grep -rn "author:.*openspec" --include="SKILL.md" .opencode/skills/ .claude/skills/` → 零结果（全部为 `corgispec`）
285	5. **CLI 源码**：`grep -rn "OpenSpec" packages/corgispec/src/` → 零结果（注意大写 O+S，不动 `openspec/` 路径）
286	6. **CLI 输出**：`corgispec --help` 输出包含 "Corgi" 而非 "OpenSpec"
287	7. **测试通过**：`cd packages/corgispec && npm test` → 全部通过
288	8. **安装实测**：`corgispec install --mode fresh --path /tmp/test-project`，检查目标文件不含 "OpenSpec"
289	9. **lint 通过**：`corgispec lint` 无错误
290	10. **路径完整性**：`grep -rn "openspec/" packages/corgispec/src/` 路径引用全部正常（验证未误删路径）
291	
292	---

13	  cat <<'EOF'
14	Usage: ./install-skills.sh [--dry-run] [--codex] [--help]
15	
16	Install this repo's user-level skills for Claude Code and OpenCode.
17	
18	What gets installed:
19	  - .claude/skills/corgispec-*        -> ~/.claude/skills/
20	  - .opencode/skills/corgispec-*      -> ~/.config/opencode/skill/
21	
22	Options:
23	  --dry-run   Print planned operations without copying files
24	  --codex     Also create Codex symlinks (~/.codex/skills/ -> ~/.claude/skills/)
25	  --help      Show this help text
26	EOF
27	}
28	
29	log() {
30	  printf '%s\n' "$1"
31	}
32	
33	copy_dir() {
34	  local src="$1"
35	  local dest_root="$2"
36	  local name
37	  name="$(basename "$src")"
38	
39	  mkdir -p "$dest_root"
40	
41	  if [[ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]]; then
42	    log "DRY-RUN install: $src -> $dest_root/$name"
43	    return 0
44	  fi
45	
46	  rm -rf "$dest_root/$name"
47	  cp -a "$src" "$dest_root/"
48	  log "Installed: $src -> $dest_root/$name"
49	}
50	
51	install_glob() {
52	  local pattern="$1"
53	  local dest_root="$2"
54	  local matched=0
55	  local path
56	  local -a paths=()
57	
58	  shopt -s nullglob
59	  paths=( $pattern )
60	  for path in "${paths[@]}"; do
61	    if [[ -d "$path" ]]; then
62	      copy_dir "$path" "$dest_root"
63	      matched=1
64	    fi
65	  done
66	  shopt -u nullglob
67	
68	  if [[ "$matched" -eq 0 ]]; then
69	    log "No matching directories for pattern: $pattern"
70	  fi
71	}
72	
73	create_symlink() {
74	  local src_dir="$1"
75	  local dest_dir="$2"
76	  local name
77	  name="$(basename "$src_dir")"
78	
79	  if [[ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]]; then
80	    log "DRY-RUN symlink: $dest_dir/$name -> $src_dir"
81	    return 0
82	  fi
83	
84	  if [[ -d "$dest_dir/$name" && ! -L "$dest_dir/$name" ]]; then
85	    log "Removing physical copy: $dest_dir/$name (replacing with symlink)"
86	    rm -rf "$dest_dir/$name"
87	  fi
88	
89	  ln -sfn "$src_dir" "$dest_dir/$name"
90	  log "Symlinked: $dest_dir/$name -> $src_dir"
91	}
92	
93	install_codex_symlinks() {
94	  log "Codex target: $CODEX_DIR"
95	
96	  mkdir -p "$CODEX_DIR"
97	
98	  local matched=0
99	  for src_dir in "$CLAUDE_DIR"/corgispec-*; do
100	    if [[ -d "$src_dir" ]]; then
101	      create_symlink "$src_dir" "$CODEX_DIR"
102	      matched=1
103	    fi
104	  done
105	
106	  if [[ "$matched" -eq 0 ]]; then
107	    log "No corgispec-* directories found in $CLAUDE_DIR. Install Claude Code skills first."
108	  fi
109	}
110	
111	for arg in "$@"; do
112	  case "$arg" in
113	    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
114	    --codex) CODEX=1 ;;
115	    --help|-h)
116	      usage
117	      exit 0
118	      ;;
119	    *)
120	      printf 'Unknown argument: %s\n\n' "$arg" >&2
121	      usage >&2
122	      exit 1
123	      ;;
124	  esac
125	done
126	
127	log "Repo root: $SCRIPT_DIR"
128	log "Claude target: $CLAUDE_DIR"
129	log "OpenCode target: $OPENCODE_DIR"
130	
131	# Install from tiered source (atoms/, molecules/) into flat user-level target
132	install_glob "$SCRIPT_DIR/.claude/skills/atoms/corgispec-*" "$CLAUDE_DIR"
133	install_glob "$SCRIPT_DIR/.claude/skills/molecules/corgispec-*" "$CLAUDE_DIR"
134	install_glob "$SCRIPT_DIR/.opencode/skills/atoms/corgispec-*" "$OPENCODE_DIR"
135	install_glob "$SCRIPT_DIR/.opencode/skills/molecules/corgispec-*" "$OPENCODE_DIR"

137	if [[ "$CODEX" -eq 1 ]]; then
138	  install_codex_symlinks
139	fi

142	if [[ "$CODEX" -eq 1 ]]; then

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	
3	set -euo pipefail
4	
5	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
6	CLAUDE_SKILLS="$SCRIPT_DIR/.claude/skills"
7	CODEX_SKILLS="$SCRIPT_DIR/.codex/skills"

12	DRY_RUN=0
13	ERRORS=0
14	
15	OS="$(uname -s 2>/dev/null || echo 'Unknown')"

17	RED='\033[0;31m'
18	GREEN='\033[0;32m'
19	YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
20	CYAN='\033[0;36m'
21	NC='\033[0m'
22	
23	usage() {
24	  cat <<'EOF'
25	Usage: ./setup.sh [--dry-run] [--help]
26	
27	One-command symlink initialization for CorgiSpec plugin structure.
28	Creates per-skill symlinks from .codex/skills/ and .agents/skills/
29	pointing to the canonical .claude/skills/ directory.
30	
31	What gets configured:
32	  .codex/skills/<tier>/corgispec-*  -> ../../../.claude/skills/<tier>/corgispec-*
33	  .agents/skills/<tier>/corgispec-* -> ../../../.claude/skills/<tier>/corgispec-*
34	
35	Options:
36	  --dry-run   Preview changes without modifying files
37	  --help      Show this help text
38	
39	Features:
40	  - Idempotent: detects existing correct symlinks, skips re-creation
41	  - Backup: detects physical copies, prompts before replacing with symlinks
42	  - Validation: checks plugin.json, counts skills, verifies symlink resolve
43	  - Windows: gracefully detects missing symlink support, provides fallback instructions
44	EOF
45	}
46	
47	log()  { printf '%b%s%b\n' "$CYAN" "$1" "$NC"; }
48	ok()   { printf '%b  ✓ %s%b\n' "$GREEN" "$1" "$NC"; }
49	warn() { printf '%b  ⚠ %s%b\n' "$YELLOW" "$1" "$NC"; }
50	err()  { printf '%b  ✗ %s%b\n' "$RED" "$1" "$NC"; ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1)); }
51	
52	is_symlink() { [[ -L "$1" ]]; }
53	is_directory() { [[ -d "$1" && ! -L "$1" ]]; }
54	
55	check_symlink_support() {
56	  local test_target
57	  test_target="$(mktemp 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
58	  local test_link="${test_target}-link"
59	  if ln -sfn "$test_target" "$test_link" 2>/dev/null; then
60	    rm -f "$test_target" "$test_link" 2>/dev/null
61	    return 0
62	  fi
63	  rm -f "$test_target" 2>/dev/null
64	  return 1
65	}
66	
67	resolve_target() {
68	  local skill_name="$1"
69	  local tier="$2"
70	  echo "../../../.claude/skills/${tier}/${skill_name}"
71	}
72	
73	needs_symlink() {
74	  local link_path="$1"
75	  local expected_target="$2"
76	  if is_symlink "$link_path"; then
77	    local current
78	    current="$(readlink "$link_path")"
79	    if [[ "$current" == "$expected_target" ]]; then
80	      return 1
81	    fi
82	  fi
83	  return 0
84	}

86	create_symlink() {
87	  local skill_dir="$1"
88	  local target_dir="$2"
89	  local label="$3"
90	  local tier="$4"
91	  local skill_name
92	  skill_name="$(basename "$skill_dir")"
93	  local tier_dir="$target_dir/$tier"
94	  local link_path="$tier_dir/$skill_name"
95	  local expected_target
96	  expected_target="$(resolve_target "$skill_name" "$tier")"
97	
98	  mkdir -p "$tier_dir"
99	
100	  if ! needs_symlink "$link_path" "$expected_target"; then
101	    ok "$label/$tier/$skill_name — already configured"
102	    return 0
103	  fi
104	
105	  if is_directory "$link_path"; then
106	    if [[ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 0 ]]; then
107	      local confirmed
108	      printf '%bPhysical directory detected: %s%b\n' "$YELLOW" "$link_path" "$NC"
109	      printf 'Replace with symlink to %s? [y/N] ' "$expected_target"
110	      read -r confirmed
111	      if [[ ! "$confirmed" =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
112	        warn "$label/$tier/$skill_name — skipped (user declined)"
113	        return 0
114	      fi

116	      mv "$link_path" "$CODEX_BACKUP/$skill_name"

118	      ln -sfn "$expected_target" "$link_path"
119	      ok "$label/$tier/$skill_name — replaced physical copy with symlink"
120	    else
121	      warn "DRY-RUN: would backup $label/$tier/$skill_name physical copy, then symlink -> $expected_target"
122	    fi
123	  elif [[ -e "$link_path" ]]; then
124	    if [[ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 0 ]]; then
125	      rm -rf "$link_path"

127	      ok "$label/$tier/$skill_name — replaced incorrect link"
128	    else
129	      warn "DRY-RUN: would replace incorrect link $label/$tier/$skill_name -> $expected_target"
130	    fi
131	  else
132	    if [[ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 0 ]]; then
133	      ln -sfn "$expected_target" "$link_path"
134	      ok "$label/$tier/$skill_name — created symlink -> $expected_target"
135	    else
136	      ok "DRY-RUN: would create $label/$tier/$skill_name -> $expected_target"
137	    fi
138	  fi
139	}
140	
141	validate() {
142	  log "Validating plugin structure..."
143	
144	  if [[ -f "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN" ]]; then
145	    if python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('$CLAUDE_PLUGIN'))" 2>/dev/null; then
146	      ok ".claude-plugin/plugin.json — valid JSON"
147	    else
148	      err ".claude-plugin/plugin.json — invalid JSON"
149	    fi
150	  else
151	    err ".claude-plugin/plugin.json — missing"
152	  fi
153	
154	  if [[ -f "$CODEX_PLUGIN" ]]; then
155	    if python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('$CODEX_PLUGIN'))" 2>/dev/null; then
156	      ok ".codex-plugin/plugin.json — valid JSON"
157	    else
158	      err ".codex-plugin/plugin.json — invalid JSON"
159	    fi
160	  else
161	    err ".codex-plugin/plugin.json — missing"
162	  fi

172	  done

174

197	          all_ok=0
198	        fi
199	      done

201	  done

203	  if [[ "$all_ok" -eq 1 ]]; then

1	# AGENTS.md
2	
3	## What this repo is
4	
5	A workflow/skills toolkit (not an app) that turns AI coding assistants into structured engineering workflows via OpenSpec. It ships skills, schemas, CLI tooling, and slash commands for Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex.
6	
7	There is no application code to build or deploy. The "product" is the skill files and their metadata.
8	
9	## Directory layout
10	
11	| Path | Role |
12	|------|------|
13	| `.opencode/skills/corgispec-*/` | **Source of truth** for skill definitions (SKILL.md + skill.meta.json) |
14	| `.opencode/commands/corgi-*.md` | OpenCode slash command dispatch |
15	| `.claude/skills/corgispec-*/` | Claude Code skill mirrors — must stay in sync with `.opencode/skills/` |
16	| `.codex/skills/corgispec-*/` | Codex skill mirrors — must stay in sync with `.opencode/skills/` |
17	| `openspec/schemas/` | Schema definitions (gitlab-tracked, github-tracked) |
18	| `openspec/config.yaml` | Project-level config (schema, isolation, context) |
19	| `schemas/skill-meta.schema.json` | JSON Schema for validating `skill.meta.json` |
20	| `packages/corgispec/` | **corgispec CLI** — unified CLI replacing ds-skills + install-skills.sh |
21	| `tools/ds-skills/` | Node CLI for skill validation + dependency graphing (legacy, use corgispec instead) |
22	| `install-skills.sh` | Installs user-level skills (legacy, use `corgispec install` instead) |
23	
24	## Commands
25	
26	### Run corgispec tests
27	
28	```bash
29	cd packages/corgispec && npm test
30	```
31	
32	Uses Vitest. Requires Node >= 18.
33	
34	### Validate all skills (the closest thing to a build/lint step)
35	
36	```bash
37	cd tools/ds-skills && npm install && node bin/ds-skills.js validate --path ../..
38	```
39	
40	### Run ds-skills tests
41	
42	```bash
43	cd tools/ds-skills && npm test
44	```
45	
46	Uses Node.js built-in test runner (`node --test`). Requires Node >= 18.
47	
48	### Other ds-skills commands
49	
50	```bash
51	node bin/ds-skills.js list --path ../..    # list all skills
52	node bin/ds-skills.js graph --path ../..   # dependency graph
53	```
54	
55	### Install skills to user level
56	
57	```bash
58	./install-skills.sh          # copies to ~/.claude/skills/ and ~/.config/opencode/skill/
59	./install-skills.sh --dry-run  # preview only
60	```
61	
62	## Skill authoring rules
63	
64	- Each skill lives in its own directory with exactly two files: `SKILL.md` (instructions) and `skill.meta.json` (metadata).
65	- `skill.meta.json` must validate against `schemas/skill-meta.schema.json`.
66	- Skill slugs are kebab-case, must match the directory name.
67	- Tier hierarchy: `atom` (no deps) -> `molecule` (depends on atoms) -> `compound` (depends on molecules/atoms).
68	- Platform field: `universal`, `github`, or `gitlab`.
69	- `corgispec-gh-*` skills are GitHub variants; unprefixed `corgispec-*` are GitLab or universal.
70	
71	## Three-directory sync obligation
72	
73	`.opencode/skills/`, `.claude/skills/`, and `.codex/skills/` must contain equivalent skill content. When editing a skill, update all three directories. The `.opencode/skills/` version is canonical.
74	
75	## No CI
76	
77	There are no CI workflows. Validation is manual via `ds-skills validate` or `corgispec validate`.
78	
79	## Config
80	
81	- `openspec/config.yaml` controls which schema (`gitlab-tracked` or `github-tracked`) is active and optional worktree isolation settings.
82	- `.opencode/package.json` only declares `@opencode-ai/plugin` — this enables skill discovery in OpenCode sessions.
83	
84	## Conventions
85	
86	- Markdown skill files reference tool names generically. Platform-specific tool mapping is handled at runtime by each AI platform.
87	- The workflow is checkpoint-based: propose -> apply (one Task Group at a time) -> review -> archive.
88	- Delta specs use ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED/RENAMED operations.
89	
90	## Coding Guidelines
91	
92	Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Merge with project-specific instructions as needed.
93	
94	> **Tradeoff:** These guidelines bias toward caution over speed. For trivial tasks, use judgment.
95	
96	### 1. Think Before Coding
97	
98	Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.
99	
100	Before implementing:
101	- State your assumptions explicitly. If uncertain, ask.
102	- If multiple interpretations exist, present them — don't pick silently.
103	- If a simpler approach exists, say so. Push back when warranted.
104	- If something is unclear, stop. Name what's confusing. Ask.
105	
106	### 2. Simplicity First
107	
108	Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.
109	
110	- No features beyond what was asked.
111	- No abstractions for single-use code.
112	- No "flexibility" or "configurability" that wasn't requested.
113	- No error handling for impossible scenarios.
114	- If you write 200 lines and it could be 50, rewrite it.
115	
116	Ask yourself: *"Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated?"* If yes, simplify.
117	
118	### 3. Surgical Changes
119	
120	Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.
121	
122	When editing existing code:
123	- Don't "improve" adjacent code, comments, or formatting.
124	- Don't refactor things that aren't broken.
125	- Match existing style, even if you'd do it differently.
126	- If you notice unrelated dead code, mention it — don't delete it.
127	
128	When your changes create orphans:
129	- Remove imports/variables/functions that YOUR changes made unused.
130	- Don't remove pre-existing dead code unless asked.
131	
132	**The test:** Every changed line should trace directly to the user's request.
133	
134	### 4. Goal-Driven Execution
135	
136	Define success criteria. Loop until verified.
137	
138	Transform tasks into verifiable goals:
139	- "Add validation" → "Write tests for invalid inputs, then make them pass"
140	- "Fix the bug" → "Write a test that reproduces it, then make it pass"
141	- "Refactor X" → "Ensure tests pass before and after"
142	
143	For multi-step tasks, state a brief plan:
144	```
145	1. [Step] → verify: [check]
146	2. [Step] → verify: [check]
147	3. [Step] → verify: [check]
148	```
149	
150	Strong success criteria let you loop independently. Weak criteria ("make it work") require constant clarification.
151	
152	---
153	
154	*These guidelines are working if: fewer unnecessary changes in diffs, fewer rewrites due to overcomplication, and clarifying questions come before implementation rather than after mistakes.*
155	
156	## Session Memory Protocol
157	
158	### Startup (every session)
159	Read in order, max 3 files:
160	1. `memory/session-bridge.md` — last session's state
161	2. `wiki/hot.md` — current project context (~500 words, hard cap 600)
162	3. `wiki/index.md` — jump to relevant domain page
163	Then read `docs/` or code as needed.
164	
165	### Retrieval Budget
166	- Startup: max 3 files (session-bridge + hot + index), then on-demand
167	- Per-question: max 2 wiki pages before answering
168	- If >5 pages needed: say "this needs a deep session"
169	
170	### File Size Limits (hard caps)
171	| File | Target | Hard Cap | Overflow Action |
172	|------|--------|----------|-----------------|
173	| wiki/hot.md | 500 words | 600 words | Trim oldest entries |
174	| wiki/index.md | 40 lines | 80 lines | Archive completed entries |
175	| memory/pitfalls.md | 10 active | 20 active | Rotate oldest 10 |
176	| memory/session-bridge.md | 30 lines | 50 lines | Archive old Done items |
177	
178	### Shutdown (every session end)
179	Update `memory/session-bridge.md`: Done / Waiting / New Pitfalls / New Discoveries
180	
181	### corgi Apply -> Long-term Memory
182	After each Task Group completes:
183	- New pitfalls -> append to `memory/pitfalls.md` (link source change)
184	- New implicit rules -> append to `wiki/architecture/implicit-contracts.md`
185	- Update `wiki/hot.md` Recent Decisions
186	
187	### Compaction Triggers (agent self-maintains)
188	- Every archive: compress session-bridge
189	- pitfalls > 20 entries: rotate oldest 10 to Archive section
190	- hot.md > 550 words: trim oldest entries
191	- Every 10 corgi sessions: suggest running /corgi-lint

11	# Decision: OpenSpec → Corgi Branding 全面替换
12	
13	> 将所有用户可见的 "OpenSpec" 品牌文本替换为 "Corgi"，使命令、Skill 描述、CLI 输出、文档与斜杠命令 `/corgi-*` 命名一致。
14	
15	## Context
16	
17	CorgiSpec 项目起源于 OpenSpec GitFlow 工作流，CLI 工具和斜杠命令已迁移到 `corgispec`/`/corgi-*` 命名体系。经 agent team 全面审查确认：**~85 个文件、~180+ 处引用** 中仍然大量保留 "OpenSpec" 品牌文本（另有 200+ 文件中的 `openspec/` 目录路径引用不在本次范围内）。
18	
19	| 位置 | 示例 | 用户影响 |
20	|------|------|---------|
21	| 命令描述 | `.opencode/commands/corgi-install.md` — "Install OpenSpec GitFlow assets" | OpenCode 命令面板显示 "OpenSpec" |
22	| Claude 命令名 | `.claude/commands/corgi/install.md` — `name: "OPSX: Install"` | Claude Code 命令列表显示 "OPSX" |
23	| Skill 描述 | `SKILL.md` frontmatter — "Implement tasks from an OpenSpec change" | Agent 执行时展示 "OpenSpec" |
24	| CLI description | `corgispec --help` — "Unified CLI for OpenSpec workflow" | 终端帮助文本显示 "OpenSpec" |
25	| 插件市场 | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` — `"displayName": "CorgiSpec - OpenSpec GitFlow"` | Codex/Claude 插件列表显示混用命名 |
26	| 资产模板 | `packages/corgispec/assets/` — 安装源模板含 "OpenSpec" | 每次 `corgi-install` 把 "OpenSpec" 重新写入目标项目 |
27	| 文档 | `AGENTS.md`, README, wiki pages, 对外文章 | 用户阅读时看到混用命名 |
28	
29	用户在 OpenCode 中执行 `/corgi-install` 时，命令面板和 Skill 执行输出仍显示 "OpenSpec"，造成品牌混淆。更严重的是，`packages/corgispec/assets/` 中的源模板未被考虑——即使改了部署文件，下一次 `corgi-install` 会重新引入 "OpenSpec" 文本。
30	
31	## Scope Definition
32	
33	### 替换规则
34	
35	- **品牌文本** `"OpenSpec"` → `"Corgi"`（大小写敏感，仅匹配大写 O+S）
36	- **目录路径** `openspec/` → **保留不变**
37	- **Code 标识符**（如 `OpenSpecConfig` 接口名、`initializeOpenSpec()` 函数名）→ **不改**（属于代码重构，非品牌问题）
38	
39	### 需要替换的（品牌文本 "OpenSpec"）
40	
41	| # | 类别 | 文件数 | 行数（估） | 说明 |
42	|---|------|--------|-----------|------|
43	| 1 | 命令 dispatch 文件 | 4 | ~8 | `.opencode/commands/corgi-*.md` + `.claude/commands/corgi/*.md` 的 description + 正文 |
44	| 2 | 🔴 **资产源模板** | **12** | ~25 | `packages/corgispec/assets/` — 命令模板(4) + Skill 模板(7) + meta.json(1)。**不改则每次 install 重新引入 OpenSpec** |
45	| 3 | Skill SKILL.md | 21 | ~40 | 三平台 × 7 个 skill 的 frontmatter + 正文 |
46	| 4 | CLI 源码 | 8 | ~15 | `corgispec.ts` description、bootstrap/doctor/init 输出文案 |
47	| 5 | skill.meta.json | 3 | ~3 | description 字段 |
48	| 6 | 测试文件 | 2 | ~5 | `init.test.ts`、`doctor.test.ts` — CLI 输出变更后断言会失败 |
49	| 7 | package.json | 1 | ~2 | npm package description（对外可见）；keywords 中的 `"openspec"` 需评估 |
50	| 8 | 插件 marketplace JSON | 3 | ~6 | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`、`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`、`.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` |
51	| 9 | README | 2 | ~20 | `README.md` + `README.zh-TW.md`（项目门面） |
52	| 10 | 文档 | 20 | ~60 | docs/ (12) + wiki/ (8) + 根配置 (2: AGENTS.md, INSTALL.md) |
53	| 11 | memory/MEMORY.md | 1 | ~2 | 项目描述中的 "OpenSpec GitFlow" |
54	
55	**总计**：约 **80-85 个文件**，~180+ 处替换。（初审估计 54 个文件，经 agent review 发现遗漏 ~30 个文件。）
56	
57	### 🔴 关键：资产源模板（assets/）
58	
59	这是初审遗漏的最严重类别。`packages/corgispec/assets/` 是 `corgispec install` 和 `corgispec bootstrap` 复制到目标项目的**源模板**。包含：
60	
61	```
62	packages/corgispec/assets/
63	├── commands/
64	│   ├── opencode/corgi-apply.md      ← 含 "OpenSpec change"
65	│   ├── opencode/corgi-install.md    ← 含 "OpenSpec GitFlow assets"
66	│   ├── claude/corgi/apply.md        ← 含 "OpenSpec change" + name: "OPSX: Apply"
67	│   └── claude/corgi/install.md      ← 含 "OpenSpec GitFlow assets" + name: "OPSX: Install"
68	├── skills/
69	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-apply-change/SKILL.md
70	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-explore/SKILL.md
71	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-gh-apply/SKILL.md
72	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-gh-explore/SKILL.md
73	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-install/SKILL.md
74	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-memory-migrate/SKILL.md
75	│   ├── molecules/corgispec-install/skill.meta.json
76	│   └── atoms/corgispec-memory-init/SKILL.md
77	└── schemas/{gitlab,github}-tracked/**  ← 无 OpenSpec 文本，无需改动
78	```
79	
80	**不改这些文件 = 每次 `corgispec install` 把 "OpenSpec" 重新写入目标项目，品牌替换全部白做。**
81	
82	### 不替换的（目录路径约定 `openspec/`）
83	
84	`openspec/` 是项目目录结构的约定名称（类似 `.git/`、`node_modules/`），不是品牌文本：
85	
86	```
87	openspec/config.yaml       ← 目录约定，不改
88	openspec/changes/          ← 目录约定，不改
89	openspec/schemas/          ← 目录约定，不改
90	openspec/specs/            ← 目录约定，不改
91	openspec/.corgi-install.json  ← 目录约定，不改
92	```
93	
94	**理由**：
95	1. `openspec/` 出现在 200+ 个文件中，改名是结构性变更，非品牌问题
96	2. `openspec/` 是跨项目的工作流标准目录名（类比 `.github/`、`.gitlab/`），改名会破坏与外部工具链的兼容性
97	3. 与本次品牌一致性目标无关
98	
99	### 不替换的（Code 标识符）
100	
101	以下 TypeScript 源码中的标识符是代码命名，不是品牌文本，不在本次范围：
102	
103	| 文件 | 标识符 | 类型 |
104	|------|--------|------|
105	| `lib/config.ts` | `OpenSpecConfig` interface | 接口名 |
106	| `commands/init.ts` | `InitializeOpenSpecOptions` | 类型别名 |
107	| `commands/init.ts` | `initializeOpenSpec()` | 函数名 |
108	| `lib/config.ts` | JSDoc `"OpenSpec config"` | 开发者文档（可选改） |
109	
110	### 不需要替换的（已正确使用 Corgi 命名的）
111	
112	- `corgispec` CLI 工具名 — 已正确
113	- `/corgi-*` 斜杠命令名 — 已正确
114	- `corgispec-*` Skill 目录名 — 已正确
115	- `packages/corgispec/` 包名 — 已正确
116	
117	## 命名一致性问题
118	
119	Agent review 发现提议的 "Corgi" 品牌与现存多处命名存在冲突，需在替换时统一决策：
120	
121	### 冲突矩阵
122	
123	| 现存名称 | 出现位置 | 与 "Corgi" 的关系 | 建议处理 |
124	|----------|---------|-------------------|---------|
125	| `"CorgiSpec"` | 3 个插件 `displayName` | 多出 "Spec" 后缀 | 改为 `"Corgi"`，与决策一致 |
126	| `"Coding Corgi Flow"` | README 标题 | 产品线全名 | 保留作为产品全名，简化引用用 "Corgi" |
127	| `"Corgi Flow"` | README 正文 | 产品简称 | 保留，与 "Corgi" 品牌不冲突 |
128	| `"OPSX: *"` | 6 个 Claude 命令 `name` 字段 | OpenSpec X 缩写残余 | 改为 `"Corgi: *"` |
129	| `"CorgiSpec - OpenSpec GitFlow"` | `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` | 混用 | 改为 `"Corgi"` |
130	
131	### `OPSX` 缩写残余
132	
133	`.claude/commands/corgi/*.md` 中 6 个文件的 `name` frontmatter 使用 `"OPSX: XXX"`：
134	
135	```
136	apply.md:    name: "OPSX: Apply"
137	install.md:  name: "OPSX: Install"
138	propose.md:  name: "OPSX: Propose"
139	review.md:   name: "OPSX: Review"
140	archive.md:  name: "OPSX: Archive"
141	explore.md:  name: "OPSX: Explore"
142	```
143	
144	需全部改为 `"Corgi: XXX"`，包括对应的 assets/ 源模板。
145	
146	### `metadata.author: "openspec"`（小写）
147	
148	SKILL.md frontmatter 中的 `metadata.author: "openspec"` 是小写，case-sensitive grep 会漏掉。需单独搜 `author:` 字段，替换为 `"corgispec"`（匹配 CLI 工具名）。
149	
150	### 外部归属引用（不可改）
151	
152	以下是对上游项目 Fission-AI/OpenSpec 的真实引用，**必须保留**：
153	- README 中 "OpenSpec 的社区扩展"、"原生 OpenSpec vs. Corgi Flow"
154	- 指向 `https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec` 的链接
155	- 对外文章中标明 "基于 OpenSpec 构建" 的归属声明
156	
157	区分标准：如果 "OpenSpec" 指的**是 Fission AI 的项目** → 保留；如果指**本项目/本工作流** → 替换为 "Corgi"。
158	
159	## 特殊情况处理
160	
161	| 原文 | 处理方式 | 原因 |
162	|------|---------|------|
163	| `"OPSX: Install"` (Claude 命令 name) | → `"Corgi: Install"` | OPSX = OpenSpec X 缩写残余 |
164	| `"Unified CLI for OpenSpec workflow"` (corgispec.ts, package.json) | → `"Unified CLI for Corgi workflow"` | CLI + npm 自身描述 |
165	| `"OpenSpec GitFlow"` | → `"Corgi GitFlow"` | 组合品牌名 |
166	| `"OpenSpec Awareness"` (explore skill heading) | → `"Corgi Awareness"` | Skill 章节标题，指本工作流系统 |
167	| `"OpenSpec managed files"` (install skill legacy message) | → `"Corgi managed files"` | Skill 运行时消息，指本项目管理文件 |
168	| `metadata.author: "openspec"` (小写) | → `"corgispec"` | 小写 frontmatter 值，case-sensitive grep 会漏掉 |
169	| `"openspec/..."` (目录路径) | **保留不变** | 目录约定，非品牌文本 |
170	| `"openspec-llm-memory"` (文件名) | **保留不变** | 文件名约定，历史文档标识 |
171	| `"OpenSpec"` 指 Fission AI 上游项目 | **保留不变** | 外部归属，非本项目品牌 |
172	| `OpenSpecConfig` / `initializeOpenSpec()` (TS 标识符) | **保留不变** | 代码命名，非品牌文本 |
173	| `"keywords": ["openspec", ...]` (package.json) | 待定 | npm 关键词：改则丢失可发现性，不改则留 "openspec" 残余 |
174	| `.codex/skills.backup/` vs `.codex/skills/` | **先同步，再替换** | backup 目录内容与主目录不一致（缺失 Context Gate 模式），直接编辑会掩盖差异 |
175	
176	## Decision
177	
178	**全面替换品牌文本 "OpenSpec" → "Corgi"，保留 `openspec/` 目录路径和外部归属引用不变。**
179	
180	执行原则：
181	1. **品牌文本替换**：所有 description、frontmatter、CLI 输出、文档正文中的 "OpenSpec" → "Corgi"
182	2. **目录路径保留**：`openspec/config.yaml`、`openspec/changes/` 等路径引用保持不变
183	3. **文件名保留**：`openspec-llm-memory.md` 等历史文档文件名中的 "openspec" 保留
184	4. **Code 标识符保留**：`OpenSpecConfig`、`initializeOpenSpec()` 等 TS 标识符不改
185	5. **外部归属保留**：指向 Fission-AI/OpenSpec 的引用和链接不变
186	6. **资产源模板必改**：`packages/corgispec/assets/` 必须同步替换，否则每次 install 重新引入 "OpenSpec"
187	7. **三平台同步**：`.opencode/skills/`、`.claude/skills/`、`.codex/skills.backup/` 同时替换
188	8. **先记录决策，后执行**：本决策文档作为变更依据，实际替换在审批后单独执行
189	
190	## Implementation Plan
191	
192	分 4 个阶段，按「风险 × 可验证性」排序：低风险先做建立信心，有编译器安全网的先做降低 review 成本。
193	
194	### Phase 0: 前置准备
195	
196	- 将 `.codex/skills.backup/` 内容同步到与 `.opencode/skills/` 一致（当前 backup 目录缺失 Context Gate 模式，内容过期）
197	- 确认 `package.json` keywords 中 `"openspec"` 的处理策略
198	
199	### Phase 1: 命令 dispatch 文件（低风险，用户直接可见）
200	
201	- 6 个文件（`.opencode/commands/corgi-*.md` × 2 + `.claude/commands/corgi/*.md` × 4）
202	- 改动量：frontmatter description + 正文首段 + `name: "OPSX: *"` → `"Corgi: *"`
203	- **验证**：OpenCode 命令面板无 "OpenSpec"；Claude Code `/corgi:install` 显示 "Corgi: Install"
204	
205	### Phase 2: 资产源模板 + CLI 源码（中风险，编译器安全网）
206	
207	**2a. assets/ 源模板：**
208	- 12 个文件（命令模板 4 + Skill 模板 7 + meta.json 1）
209	- 与 Phase 1 、Phase 3 的对应文件内容镜像一致
210	- **验证**：`corgispec install --mode fresh` 到测试项目，检查目标文件不含 "OpenSpec"
211	
212	**2b. CLI 源码：**
213	- 8 个 .ts 文件（只改字符串字面量，不动标识符和 `openspec/` 路径）
214	- **验证**：`npm test` 全部通过（测试文件需同步改断言字符串）
215	
216	Phase 2a 和 2b 可并行。
217	
218	### Phase 3: Skill 定义文件（中风险，需人工 diff review）
219	
220	- 21 个 SKILL.md（三平台各 7 个）+ 3 个 skill.meta.json
221	- 改动量：frontmatter description + 正文关键位置
222	- 每文件改动点：2-5 处
223	- 需注意：`metadata.author: "openspec"` → `"corgispec"`（小写，case-sensitive grep 会漏）
224	- 需注意：`corgispec-install` skill 运行时消息 "This project has OpenSpec managed files"
225	- **验证**：`grep -rn "OpenSpec" --include="SKILL.md" .opencode/skills/ .claude/skills/ .codex/skills.backup/` → 零结果
226	
227	### Phase 4: 文档、插件配置、README（低风险，纯文案）
228	
229	- 插件 marketplace JSONs (3)：displayName + description
230	- README (2)：正文中的品牌引用（保留外部归属）
231	- 文档 (20)：docs/ + wiki/ + AGENTS.md + INSTALL.md
232	- memory/MEMORY.md (1)
233	- **验证**：`grep -rn "OpenSpec" --include="*.md" --include="*.json" .` (排除 openspec/ 路径后 → 零品牌引用)
234	
235	## Risk Assessment
236	
237	| 风险 | 等级 | 缓解措施 |
238	|------|------|---------|
239	| `openspec/` 路径误替换 | 🔴 高 | 大小写区分：替换 "OpenSpec"（大写 O+S），不动 "openspec/"（小写）。每阶段后用 `grep` 验证 |
240	| assets/ 源模板遗忘 | 🔴 高 | Phase 2a 独立处理，用 `corgispec install --mode fresh` 实测验证 |
241	| 资产模板与部署文件不一致 | 🟡 中 | assets/ 和 .opencode/commands/ / .claude/commands/ 必须镜像一致，diff 验证 |
242	| Skill 文本改动影响 Agent 行为 | 🟡 中 | 仅改品牌词（"OpenSpec change" → "Corgi change"），不改指令语义或逻辑结构 |
243	| 三平台 skill 文件不同步 | 🟡 中 | Phase 3 三平台同时改；Phase 0 先同步 .codex |
244	| 测试断言因 CLI 文案变更而失败 | 🟡 中 | Phase 2b 包含测试文件更新；`npm test` 作为验证步骤 |
245	| 小写 `author: openspec` 被漏掉 | 🟡 中 | 单独 grep `author:` frontmatter 字段，不依赖 case-sensitive "OpenSpec" 搜索 |
246	| 误改对 Fission-AI/OpenSpec 的外部归属 | 🟡 中 | README 和对外文章中「指上游项目」的 "OpenSpec" 手动排除 |
247	| 文档中历史引用混乱 | 🟢 低 | 活跃文档改品牌文本，历史研究/归档文档保留原引用 |
248	| package.json keywords 取舍 | 🟢 低 | 单独决策：npm 可发现性 vs 品牌一致性 |
249	
250	## Alternatives Considered
251	
252	- **只改命令描述**：改动量最小，但 Skill 执行时 Agent 仍输出 "OpenSpec"，品牌不一致未根治。拒绝。
253	- **改成 "CorgiSpec"**：保留 "Spec" 后缀体现规格化定位。但插件 displayName 已是 "CorgiSpec"，README 是 "Coding Corgi Flow"，命令是 `/corgi-*`，再加一个品牌名造成 4 种命名并存。拒绝。
254	- **改成 "Corgi Flow"**：与 README 简称一致。但 CLI help 和 Skill 描述中 "Corgi Flow workflow" 冗余。拒绝。
255	- **连目录一起改 `openspec/` → `corgi/`**：影响 200+ 个文件，破坏与已有项目的兼容性。属于未来独立迁移项目，与本次品牌文本替换分开。拒绝。
256	
257	## Consequences
258	
259	### 正面
260	- 用户在 OpenCode/Claude Code 中看到一致的 "Corgi" 品牌
261	- 命令名 `/corgi-*`、Skill 名 `corgispec-*`、描述文本 "Corgi" 三者一致
262	- `corgispec install` 不再把 "OpenSpec" 文本写入目标项目
263	- 消除新用户的认知混淆（"为什么 /corgi-install 装的是 OpenSpec？"）
264	
265	### 负面
266	- 80-85 个文件的批量修改有协调成本
267	- 三平台 skill 同步增加维护负担（但这是已有义务，非新增）
268	- `.codex/skills.backup/` 需先同步再改，增加前置步骤
269	- 对外已发布的文章（知乎等）中引用 "OpenSpec" 需同步更新
270	- `package.json` keywords 中的 `"openspec"` 取舍需额外决策
271	
272	### 不作为的风险
273	- 品牌分裂持续，每个新用户都会产生 "OpenSpec vs Corgi" 的困惑
274	- 随着 `/corgi-*` 命令使用量增长，OpenSpec 残余引用显得越来越突兀
275	- `corgispec install` 持续把 "OpenSpec" 写入新项目，问题扩散
276	
277	## Verification
278	
279	替换完成后需验证：
280	
281	1. **命令文件**：`grep -rn "OpenSpec\|OPSX" --include="*.md" .opencode/commands/ .claude/commands/` → 零结果
282	2. **资产模板**：`grep -rn "OpenSpec\|OPSX" --include="*.md" --include="*.json" packages/corgispec/assets/` → 零结果
283	3. **Skill 文件**：`grep -rn "OpenSpec" --include="SKILL.md" .opencode/skills/ .claude/skills/ .codex/skills.backup/` → 零结果
284	4. **小写 author**：`grep -rn "author:.*openspec" --include="SKILL.md" .opencode/skills/ .claude/skills/` → 零结果（全部为 `corgispec`）
285	5. **CLI 源码**：`grep -rn "OpenSpec" packages/corgispec/src/` → 零结果（注意大写 O+S，不动 `openspec/` 路径）
286	6. **CLI 输出**：`corgispec --help` 输出包含 "Corgi" 而非 "OpenSpec"
287	7. **测试通过**：`cd packages/corgispec && npm test` → 全部通过
288	8. **安装实测**：`corgispec install --mode fresh --path /tmp/test-project`，检查目标文件不含 "OpenSpec"
289	9. **lint 通过**：`corgispec lint` 无错误
290	10. **路径完整性**：`grep -rn "openspec/" packages/corgispec/src/` 路径引用全部正常（验证未误删路径）
291

1	# Obsidian 做思考 PM，AI Agent 做程式開發：一套「人類策展、AI 執行」的開發工作流
2	
3	> 把 Obsidian 變成你的技術長辦公室，讓 AI agent 當你的紀律嚴明的工程師——這不是科幻，是我們正在用的日常流程。
4	
5	> **[Coding Corgi Flow](https://github.com/ricoyudog/Coding_Corgi_flow) 是一個基於 OpenSpec 的開源工具鏈。如果你覺得這篇文章有啟發，歡迎去 GitHub 給我們一個 ⭐ Star——這是對開源專案最實在的支持！**
6	
7	---
8	
9	## 一、那個所有 AI Coder 都有的痛
10	
11	你用過 Cursor、Claude Code、或任何 AI coding agent 嗎？
12	
13	如果是，你大概經歷過這種循環：
14	
15	- 第一個月：**太神了**，一個 prompt 就生出整個功能，感覺自己像在開外掛
16	- 第三個月：**怪怪的**，AI 開始忘掉上禮拜你們討論過的設計決策，同一個坑踩三次
17	- 第六個月：**不敢用了**，專案變成一團「AI 義大利麵」，沒有人（包括你自己）知道為什麼那段程式碼長那樣
18	
19	核心問題不是 AI 不夠聰明。**核心問題是 AI 沒有記憶，而你把「思考」和「執行」全丟給了同一個無狀態的黑盒子。**
20	
21	---
22	
23	## 二、LLM Wiki 給的啟發：從「解釋器」到「編譯器」
24	
25	Andrej Karpathy（前 Tesla AI 總監、OpenAI 共同創辦人）提出過一個叫 **LLM Wiki** 的設計模式，裡面有一個極其關鍵的洞見：
26	
27	> 傳統 RAG 就像一個**解釋器**——每次查詢都從原始文檔重新推導答案，無狀態、無積累。
28	> LLM Wiki 則是一個**編譯器**——先把知識預先「編譯」進一個持久化的 wiki，每次新的輸入都能受益於之前所有輸入的提煉。
29	
30	| | 解釋器模型（傳統 RAG） | 編譯器模型（LLM Wiki） |

64:## 四、技術基底：我們站在 OpenSpec 的肩膀上
66:前面講了理念，現在講實作。這套工作流的技術基底是 **[OpenSpec](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec)**——由 Fission AI 開發的開源 CLI，專門管理 AI 輔助開發中的 change artifacts（proposals、specs、designs、tasks）。
68:OpenSpec 本身提供了一個簡潔的核心理念：**每次改動都是一個「change」，每個 change 產出四個 artifacts**：
75:但原生 OpenSpec 有一個缺口：它定義了 artifacts 的**結構**，卻沒有定義開發的**流程**。它不會幫你建 Issue、不會在每個階段暫停讓你 review、不會記住上次開發學到的教訓。
77:**所以我們在 OpenSpec 之上，加了五樣東西：**
79:| 原生 OpenSpec | Corgi-flow 加的 |

267:→ 把 delta spec 同步進 canonical specs → openspec/specs/

409:我們在 OpenSpec 的基礎上更進一步：**把 AI 輔助開發從「對黑盒子許願」升級成「人類策展、AI 執行、wiki 沉澱」的正向循環。**

docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:5:**摘要：** 很多团队已经能用 AI 生成 proposal、spec、design 和 tasks，真正的难点却是这些产物常常停在本地，进不了 GitHub 的 issue、review 与执行节奏。本文介绍我们如何以 OpenSpec 为底座，补齐 GitHub / Git 工作流，并用可复用 skills 减少重复劳动。
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:9:如果这一步没有打通，OpenSpec 更像一个很强的规划工具，而不是一个能稳定落地的工程工作流。我们这次做的事情，不是替代 OpenSpec，而是在它之上补齐一层更适合 GitHub 和日常 Git 开发的工作流能力。
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:17:## OpenSpec 已经做对了什么
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:19:OpenSpec 解决的是 AI 辅助开发里最基础、也最容易失控的一层：change artifacts，也就是 proposal、spec、design、tasks 这一组变更产物。它把这些东西组织成一个清晰的 change lifecycle，让团队不是“想到什么写什么”，而是围绕一个明确变更来生成、讨论和推进。
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:21:这一点非常重要，因为没有 artifact pipeline，后面的执行、review 和协作几乎都会变成即兴发挥。也正因为 OpenSpec 已经把这层底座搭好了，我们才有空间继续往上补：让这些 artifacts 真正进入 GitHub 和 Git 的日常工作流。
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:23:## 我们在 OpenSpec 之上补了什么
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:25:我们没有去改写 OpenSpec 的核心思路，而是在它之上补了一层更适合 GitHub 用户的 workflow glue。对普通开发者来说，最关键的不是“再多一个能生成文档的工具”，而是这些文档能不能继续流进 issue 跟踪、分组执行、review 节点和 Git 隔离。
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:27:| OpenSpec 底座 | 我们补上的能力 | 这对 GitHub 用户意味着什么 |
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:99:如果你已经在用 OpenSpec，最值得尝试的，不一定是立刻把整套流程一次性铺满，而是先挑一个 feature-sized change 跑通：从 propose 开始，到 apply、review，最后 archive。只要这条链路真的跑通一次，你就会很快感受到差别：OpenSpec 不再只是“帮你写文档”，而是开始进入你真正的 GitHub 工程流程。
docs\superpowers\articles\2026-04-28-openspec-github-workflow-zhihu.md:101:对我们来说，这也是这次扩展最核心的目标：不是把 OpenSpec 换掉，而是让它更适合真实团队、更适合 GitHub 用户，也更适合那些想把 AI workflow 从 demo 拉到工程实践的人。
